skills.name: Precious Cards of the Dark
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect once per turn and up to twice per Duel if your Deck contains 6 or more DARK monsters.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard, then draw 2 cards. If it is the first turn of the player going second, draw 1 additional card.

skills.name: Eyes of Sovereign Defiance
skills.desc:
You can only use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, and during your Main Phase, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except FIRE monsters and "Diabellstar the Black Witch".
2: Can be activated by revealing 1 Level 1 "Snake-Eye" monster or 1 "Diabellstar the Black Witch" in your hand. Add up to 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, choosing from "Sinful Spoils" Spell/Trap Cards and "Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye".
3: Can be activated if only your opponent controls a monster. Send 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your Deck to the Graveyard, and Set 1 "WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils" from your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: The Eye of the United Dragon
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 15 or more "Dark Magician" and/or cards that mention it.
1:Activated at the beginning of the Duel. If you are going first, during the first turn, your opponent will take no effect damage from your effects.
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck. Play 1 "Timaeus the United Dragon" from your hand, then add a total of 2 cards among "Dark Magician" and/or a card(s) that mentions it from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a "Dark Magician", or your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" that has a different name than the monsters you control from your Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), then add 1 "The Eye of Timaeus" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Beasts from the Abyss
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except LIGHT or DARK monsters that are Level 8 or higher.
2: Reveal 1 "Bystial" monster or 1 "Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous" in your hand. Send 1 "Fallen of Albaz" from your Deck to the Graveyard, and add 1 "Bystial" monster and 1 monster that mentions "Fallen of Albaz", except "Fallen of Albaz", from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be activated if only your opponent controls a monster. Send 1 "The Bystial Alba Los" from outside your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Bystial" monster from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Divine Dragons
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT]
Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Twice per Duel if going first, thrice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT]
Place 1 "Eternity Ether Dragon" from your Deck on top of your Deck. During the Draw Phase this turn, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards. This turn, if you Tribute Summon "Eternity Ether Dragon" in Attack Position, each monster on your field can be treated as 2 Tributes.

skills.name: Miracle Neos Contact
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 12 Fusion Monsters to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you can only Special Summon "Neos", "Elemental HERO", and "Neo-Spacian" monsters, and you can activate "Super Polymerization" and "Favorite Contact" the turn they are Set.
2: Reveal 1 "Elemental HERO Spirit of Neos" or "Miracle Ejector" from your hand. Add 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck and 1 "Polymerization" from outside of your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control "Elemental HERO Spirit of Neos" or your opponent controls a monster, Set up to 1 "Super Polymerization" and up to 1 "E - Emergency Call" from your Deck to your field.

skills.name: I'll Show You Perfection!
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the start of your first turn, send 1 "Cyber Dragon" from your Deck to the Graveyard. During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Reveal 1 "Cyber Dragon" or "Cyber Jormungardr" from your hand. Add up to 2 Level 2 or lower "Cyber Dragon" monsters from your Deck to your hand. Then, Set 1 "Cybernetic Overflow" from outside of your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)
3: From turn 2 onward, add up to 3 "Cyber Dragon" from your Deck and/or Graveyard to your hand. During this Duel, unless you successfully Special Summon "Cyber End Dragon", you cannot activate the effects of Spell Cards other than "Polymerization" and "Power Bond".

skills.name: A World of Ice and Water
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, except for effect damage from "Icejade Curse".
2: Reveal 1 Level 7 WATER Tuner in your hand and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Add up to 2 "Icejade" cards from your Deck to your hand. Then, Set 1 "Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle" from outside your Deck to your field.
3: If there is a Level 10 Synchro Monster on the field or your opponent controls a monster, choose 1 "Icejade" monster from your Deck that does not have the same name as any monster you control, and play it in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, Set 1 "Icejade" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Light the Way to the Future
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, except for effect damage from cards that mention "Shining Sarcophagus".
2: Reveal 1 Spellcaster monster that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" from your hand. Add up to 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, choosing from "Shining Sarcophagus" and monsters that mention it. If only your opponent controls a card, you can also play 1 "Silent Swordsman Zero" from your hand or Deck.
3: From turn 2 onward, send 1 "Silent Swordsman Zero" from your field to the Graveyard, then play 1 "Silent Swordsman LV7" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) If you control "Shining Sarcophagus", add 1 "Silent Sword Slash" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Activated Wyrm of Black Metal
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, reveal 1 "Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" or "Destructor Soldier Helmet" from your hand if all of the monsters in your Deck are Wyrm Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 cards from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, from among Level 8 monsters, monsters with 400 DEF, "Fusion", Field Spell Cards, and Equip Spell Cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Mathmech Slicer
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 "Primathmech Alembertian" and 3 "Mathmech Circular" from outside your Deck to your Deck or Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Mathmech" monsters, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, and if your "Mathmech" Synchro Monster attacks a Defense Position monster, and the attacking monster's ATK is higher than the defense of the target, inflict battle damage equal to the difference between the attacking monster's ATK and the target's DEF.
2: Reveal 1 "Mathmech" Tuner from your hand and send 1 card from your hand or field to the Graveyard, then add 2 "Mathmech" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If it is turn 2 onward, you can also set 1 "Mathmech" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Precious Cards of the Light
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect once per turn and up to twice per Duel if your Deck contains 6 or more LIGHT monsters.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard, then draw 2 cards. If it is the first turn of the player going second, draw 1 additional card.

skills.name: Illusion of Execution
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT]
Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Spellcaster Type, and all Level 5 or higher monsters are "Dark Magician", "Dark Magician Girl", or "Dark Eradicator Sorcerer".
[EFFECT]
Excavate the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can add 1 Spell Card from the excavated cards to your hand, and send the remaining cards to your Graveyard. Then, you can send 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck to the Graveyard. (Once per Duel.)

skills.name: Whispers of Good and Evil
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add Pendulum Zones to your field. During this Duel, your opponent cannot target "Vaalmonica" in your Pendulum Zone with card effects.
2: Reveal 1 "Vaalmonica" monster from your hand and add 1 "Vaalmonica" card from your Deck to your hand.
3: If your opponent controls a card, Set 1 "Vaalmonica" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.) If you Set the card from your hand, draw two cards and shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck.

skills.name: Bonds of the Converging Stars
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 5 Synchro Monsters to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you can activate "Converging Wishes" from your hand, but you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except Dragon Synchro Monsters, "Warrior" Synchro Monsters, "Junk" or "Stardust" monsters, or Tuners.
2: Can be activated by shuffling 2 cards from your hand into the Deck, including a Level 4 "Stardust" monster or "Shining Star Dragon". Play 2 Level 4 "Stardust" monsters from your Deck, add 1 "Shining Star Dragon" from your Deck to your hand, and send 2 monsters from outside your Deck to the Graveyard. (These cards can be Special Summoned.)
3: If you control "Crimson Dragon", or if your opponent controls a monster, from among the 5 Signer Dragons outside the Deck, play 2 non-Tuners (at random, but treat their Levels as 2) and 1 Tuner.

skills.name: Precious Cards of the Wind
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect once per turn and up to twice per Duel if your Deck contains 6 or more WIND monsters.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard, then draw 2 cards. If it is the first turn of the player going second, draw 1 additional card.

skills.name: The Power of D: Weaving the Future
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, you can only Normal or Special Summon Level 8 or lower monsters that are DARK, FIRE, or WIND "HERO" monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "HERO" monster in your hand and shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck. Add up to 2 cards in total from your Deck to your hand, choosing from DARK "HERO" monsters and/or "Fusion Destiny", then add 1 "D - Force" from outside of your Deck to your hand. If your opponent controls a card, also play 1 "Destiny HERO - Doom Lord" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
3: From turn 2 onward, place 1 "D - Tactics" from outside of your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. During this Duel, unless you successfully Special Summon "Destiny End Dragoon", you cannot activate the effects of cards other than "Polymerization" and "Fusion Destiny".

skills.name: Infernity Revival
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 10 or more "Infernity" monsters.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, you can only Special Summon 1 monster with an original Level of 9 or higher once per turn, and once per turn, you can activate 1 "Infernity" Trap Card during the turn it was Set.
2: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your hand that are "This Creepy Little Punk" or "Infernity" monsters into the Deck. Send "Infernity" monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard equal to the number shuffled, and if you do, add 1 "Infernity" card from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. Play 3 "Infernity" monsters (1 Level 2, 1 Level 3, 1 Level 4) from your hand and/or Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Their battle positions can be changed.) While a monster played by this effect is on your field, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.

skills.name: The Courage to Rise
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Centur-Ion" monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your hand, then add 1 "Centur-Ion" card from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control "Centur-Ion Legatia", or your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Emblema" card from your Deck to your hand. Then send 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard or place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap Card.

skills.name: Intertwining Memories
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second effect once per turn and twice per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters except for cards that mention "Fallen of Albaz" or "Fallen of Albaz", or "Ecclesia", "Tri-Brigade", "Springans", "Swordsoul", or "Icejade" monsters. If your opponent has a card on their field or in their Graveyard, you can Normal Summon 1 monster during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2: Reveal 1 "Fallen of Albaz" or 1 monster that mentions it, then add a total of 2 cards among "Ecclesia", "Tri-Brigade", "Springans", "Swordsoul", "Icejade" cards, and/or "Branded in High Spirits" from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Thorns of Hatred in Full Bloom
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 Synchro Monsters to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.) During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, except for effect damage from "Black Rose Garden" and "Bramble Rose Dragon".
2: Reveal 1 "Twilight Rose Black Knight" or "Vengeful Witch" in your hand. Add 2 cards that mention "Black Rose Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. Then, return 1 card from your hand to your Deck.
3: If you control "Bramble Rose Dragon" or your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Rage Rose Witch" from your Extra Deck or Graveyard and send 1 "Glow-Up Bulb" from outside your Deck to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Doom Ushering Gale
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except DARK Dragon monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Rokket Loader" or "Boot Sector Launch" from your hand and return 1 card from your hand to the Deck. Then, add up to 2 "Rokket" monsters, "Absorouter Dragon", and/or "Quick Launch" from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control "Borrelend Dragon", or if only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Borrel" monster with 3000 ATK from your Extra Deck or GY, or add 1 "Red Reboot" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Immi Special
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 8 monster with 1000 DEF from your hand if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE Attribute Aqua Type monsters, except those with 500 DEF.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 cards (Normal Monsters with 1200 or less ATK or 0 DEF, and/or "Nuvia the Mischievous", and or "Rainapolis") from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. This turn, your monsters can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of Level 8 monsters with 1000 DEF in Attack Position.

skills.name: Hero Rush Rising
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated by sending 1 card from your field to the Graveyard, if all of the monsters with 1600 or more ATK in your constructed Deck are LIGHT Attribute Warrior Type monsters and all of the monsters in your constructed Extra Deck are Warrior Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up monster on the field lose 600 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

skills.name: Invincible Crimson Star
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 Synchro Monsters to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you can cannot Normal Summon or Special Summon any monsters, except DARK Dragon Synchro Monsters, Level 5 or lower Dragon or Fiend monsters, or "Crimson Dragon".
2: Send 1 card from your hand and 1 card you control to the Graveyard, then play 1 Level 8 "Red Dragon Archfiend" monster from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) If "Red Familiar" was sent to the Graveyard for this activation, you can also play up to 2 "Resonator" monsters from your Deck.
3: If you control "Red Nova Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, add 1 Dragon or Fiend Tuner from your Deck to your hand, then Set 1 "Fiendish Chain" from outside your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Deep Blue of the Mother Ocean
skills.desc:
You can use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 10 or more "Marincess" cards.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except WATER monsters, and any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, except effect damage of "Marincess" cards.
2: Reveal 1 Level 4 "Marincess" monster or "Marincess" Spell Card from your hand, then add up to 2 "Marincess" monsters from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard or shuffle it into the Deck.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, or you control a Link 4 monster, add 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 "Marincess Wonder Heart" from your Extra Deck in your Extra Monster Zone.

skills.name: Princess Adena's Protection
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Mystical Elf" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
3: If you control a "Mystical Elf", draw 1 card and excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck. Then, add 1 of the cards to your hand and shuffle the other back into your Deck.

skills.name: Requiem Contact
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT]
Can be activated from turn 2 onward, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are DARK Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.
[EFFECT]
Place 1 "Voidvelg Requiem" or Normal Monster from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. This turn, if you Tribute Summon "Voidvelg Requiem" in Attack Position, each monster on your field can each be treated as 2 Tributes. Then, you can draw 1 card. (Once per Duel.)

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Galaxy-Eyes
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per turn if your Extra Deck contains 2 different "Number 107" Xyz Monsters.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Tachyon Transmigration" to your Deck, and place all "Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One" in your Deck on the bottom of the Deck. During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except Level 4 or 8 LIGHT or DARK Dragon monsters or Xyz Monsters.
2: Reveal 1 Level 8 Dragon monster or 1 "Tachyon" card from your hand. Add 1 Level 4 or 8 LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be used before your normal draw. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One" from your Deck.

skills.name: Hard Rock Overture
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated by sending 1 Level 7 or 8 monster from your hand to the Graveyard if all of the monsters in your Deck and Extra Deck are LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Place up to 2 Level 7 or 8 monsters from your hand and/or Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. If it is turn 2 onward, you can also add 1 Level 7 or 8 monster from your Graveyard to your hand. While the monsters placed on the field using this effect are face-up, their battle positions can only be changed by card effects. This turn, monsters with an original Level of 7 or higher can attack directly only once.

skills.name: The Unsealed Forbidden Door
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "The Seal of Orichalcos" from outside of your Deck to your field. During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, and you can only Normal or Special Summon Machine monsters.
2: If you have activated "The Seal of Orichalcos" this Duel, reveal 1 Level 5 or higher Machine monster in your hand. Choose 3 Level 7 or higher Machine monsters with different names from your Deck. Add 1 of them to your hand, and send the rest to the GY.
3: Send up to 2 monsters from your field to the GY, and add that many number of Level 7 or higher Machine monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Avaricious Destiny Draw
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Once per Duel if going first, twice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 "Pot of Avarice" from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Leader of the Seven
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill’s second and third effects once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains 2 different "Number 101" Xyz Monsters and "CXyz Barian Hope".
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 20 different Xyz Monsters to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you can only Normal or Special Summon Fish monsters and Xyz Monsters, and you can Normal Summon 1 monster during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2. Reveal 1 Level 5 Fish monster from your hand, then add up to 2 Fish "Shark" monsters or "Xyz" Spell/Trap Cards from the Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
3: Can be used before your normal draw. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One" from outside your Deck.

skills.name: Galactica Fusion Draw
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Galaxy Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Send up to 2 Level 7 LIGHT Attribute monsters and/or "Fusion" from your hand to the Graveyard, then draw the same number of cards. If you sent "Galactica Oblivion" to the Graveyard by this effect, you can also add 1 "Extra Plorer", "Secret Order", or "Fusion" from outside your Deck to your hand. (Once per Duel.)

skills.name: Master of the Dark & Chaos
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except for Level 8 LIGHT or EARTH monsters and DARK Spellcaster monsters.
2: Reveal 1 DARK Spellcaster monster from your hand, then shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck. Next, send 1 "Dark Magician Girl" from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard, then add a combination of "Dark Magician" and/or another card that mentions it for a total of 2 cards from your Deck to your hand.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Ultimate Fusion" from outside your Deck to your hand. Then, play 1 "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" in face-down Defense Position and send 1 "Black Luster Soldier" to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Meteor Black Rising
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" or "Meteor Dragon" from your hand if all of the Level 5 or higher monsters in your constructed Deck are "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", "Meteor Dragon", and/or "Meteor Drake" cards.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", "Meteor Dragon", or "Meteor Flare Fusion" card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. (Each card once per Duel).

skills.name: Number Galaxy
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1. You can only Normal or Special Summon "Number", "Galaxy", or "Photon" monsters and Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. When using a "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" or "Galaxy-Eyes Afterglow Dragon" as material to Xyz Summon, you can treat its Level as 4.
2. During your Main Phase, play 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" or "Galaxy-Eyes Afterglow Dragon" from your hand, then shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck. Then, add 1 "Galaxy" or "Photon" monster to your hand. If you played "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon", you can add 2 cards to your hand instead.
3. If only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord" from outside your Deck.

skills.name: Reign of Shadows
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 6 "Shaddoll" monsters with different names to your Extra Deck and send 3 random "Shaddoll" Normal Trap Cards from your Deck to the Graveyard. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters with a Level, except "Shaddoll" monsters and Spellcaster monsters.
2: Reveal 2 "Shaddoll" cards in your hand, then add 1 "Shaddoll" card from your Deck to your hand. If only your opponent controls a monster, you can also play 1 "Shaddoll" monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Wings to the Heavens
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Black-Winged Dragon" and 1 "Blackwing Armor Master" to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon Effect Monsters, except "Blackwing" monsters and Level 10 or lower DARK Dragon or Winged Beast Synchro Monsters.
2: Reveal 1 monster in your hand that mentions "Black-Winged Dragon". Add 2 "Blackwing" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
3: If you control a "Blackwing" Synchro Monster, or if your opponent controls a monster. Play 1 "Blackwing Armor Master" from your Extra Deck or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, add 1 "Blackbird Close" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Climax Omega
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 7 or higher monster or a Normal Monster from your hand if all the monsters in your constructed Deck are Psychic Type and all of the Level 7 or higher monsters are "Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" and/or "Esperade the Smashing Superstar".
[Effect] Add up to 2 monsters that are Level 1, 4, or 7 LIGHT Attribute monsters, Normal Monsters, and/or "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: A Shining Miracle Arrives
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
 1: During this Duel, you can only Normal or Special Summon "Crimson Dragon", WIND Dragon Synchro Monsters, "Stardust" monsters, and Tuners.
2: Return 2 cards from your hand to your Deck, including a Level 1 LIGHT monster with 0 ATK and DEF. Play 2 Level 4 "Stardust" monsters from your Deck, and Set up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards that mention "Stardust Dragon" from your Deck to your field.
3: If you control "Stardust Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, choose up to 3 Level 1 LIGHT Dragon monsters from your Deck. Add 1 of them to your hand and send the rest to the Graveyard.

skills.name: D/D Secondment
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add Pendulum Zones to your field, and add 6 "D/D/D" monsters to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except "D/D" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Reveal 1 Level 4 "D/D" Pendulum Monster from your hand, then take 2 "D/D" monsters from your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, and send the other to your Graveyard.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, send up to 2 "D/D" monsters from your Deck or Extra Deck to the Graveyard. Then, Set 1 "D/D" Trap Card or 1 "Dark Contract" Trap Card from your hand to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Dark Stirring of the Dreadful Dolls
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains "Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force".
1. At the beginning of the Duel, add 3 "Mansion of the Dreadful Dolls" cards to your Deck, and 4 "Gimmick Puppet" Xyz Monsters to your Extra Deck. If you are going first, during the first turn, you cannot place monsters in your opponent's Main Monster Zone, and your opponent will take no effect damage from your effects.
2. Reveal 1 "Gimmick Puppet Rouge Doll" card from your hand, then shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck. Then, add 1 "Gimmick Puppet" monster or 1 "Mansion of the Dreadful Dolls" from your Deck to your hand.
3. If you control a "Gimmick Puppet" Xyz Monster, or if only your opponent controls a monster, Set 1 "Puppet" Trap Card or 1 "Xyz" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Hyper Cannon Activation
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains "XYZ-Hyper Dragon Cannon".
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 3 LIGHT Machine Fusion Monsters to your Extra Deck and banish 3 monsters from outside of your Deck. During this Duel, you can only Normal or Special Summon "Obelisk the Tormentor", "X-Cross Cannon", or LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: During your main phase, play 1 LIGHT Machine Union monster from your hand, then add 1 Level 4 LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a Level 8 or 9 LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster, or if your opponent controls a monster, set 1 Spell/Trap Card that mentions "Union monster" in its text from your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Odd-Eyes Venomous Affection
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add Pendulum Zones to your field. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Magician" / "Performapal" Pendulum Monsters and "Performapal", "Odd-Eyes", and "Predaplant" monsters. Monsters you control whose original name is "Odd-Eyes Venom Dragon" can attack directly.
2: Reveal 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster in your hand, then play 1 "Performapal Odd-Eyes Dissolver" from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), and place 1 "Timegazer Magician" from outside of your Deck in your Pendulum Zone. Then, you can add 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Sanctuary of the King's Treasures
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 15 or more Trap Cards.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, place 1 "Temple of the Kings" from outside your Deck face-up on your field. You cannot activate the effect of "Temple of the Kings" on your first turn.
2: If you control a Continuous Trap Card, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, return any number of Continuous Spell Cards and/or Continuous Trap Cards to your hand. Then, Set 2 Continuous Trap Cards from your Deck that can Special Summon themselves as monsters. (These cards can be activated the same turn.)
3: From turn 2 onward, add 1 Level 10 monster from your Deck or 1 "Mystical Beast of Serket" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Sky Striker Ace Defying Fate
skills.desc:
You can use each of this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains 1 or more "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" and 9 or more "Sky Striker" Spell Cards.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, add 4 "Sky Striker Ace" Link Monsters with different names to your Extra Deck (except monsters that your Extra Deck already contains 3 copies of), and place 1 "Sky Striker Airspace - Area Zero" from outside of your Deck face-up in your Field Zone.
2: Send up to 2 "Sky Striker" cards from your hand and/or field (either face-up or face-down) to the Graveyard, then draw 1 card.

skills.name: Alchemy Blaze
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, reveal 1 "Chemicalized Salamander", "Chromatographagus", or "Ember the Super Assistant" in your hand if all the monsters in your Deck are FIRE Attribute Pyro Type monsters with 100 or more DEF.
[EFFECT] Add 2 cards from your Deck and/or Graveyard to your hand (either Normal Monsters, monsters with 1500 DEF, or "Fusion"), then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Beetrooper Raid
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel. 
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "Beetrooper Formation" from outside your Deck, then send 2 Insect monsters, including "Beetrooper" monsters, from your Deck to the Graveyard. For the rest of this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except Insect monsters.
2: If you control an Insect monster with 3000 or more ATK, or your opponent controls a monster, gain 3000 LP. Then, add 1 Level 5 or higher Insect monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, or Set 1 "Beetrooper" Spell/Trap  card from your Deck or Graveyard. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Goblin Bikers on a Rampage
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, and you can only Special Summon Xyz Monsters from your Extra Deck.
2: Reveal 1 "Goblin Biker Dugg Charger" or "Goblin Biker Grand Entrance" in your hand. Add up to 2 "Goblin Biker" monsters from your Deck to your hand. Then, you can Set 1 "Goblin Biker Grand Bash" from your Deck to your field.
3: If you control "Goblin Biker Big Gabonga" or only your opponent controls a monster, Set 1 "Goblin Biker" Trap Card from your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Power Rush
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, revealing 1 monster with 2500 ATK from your hand if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Level 7 or below LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters with either 1600 or less ATK or 2400 or more ATK, and either 200 DEF or 1600 or more DEF.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 monsters (max. 1 each) with 200 DEF from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Precious Cards of the Water
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect once per turn and up to twice per Duel if your Deck contains 6 or more WATER monsters.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard, then draw 2 cards. If it is the first turn of the player going second, draw 1 additional card.

skills.name: The Power of All Creation
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn, and the third effect once per Duel.
1: You can Normal Summon 1 "Primal Dragon, the
Primordial" in addition to your regular Normal Summon/Set, and your opponent takes no effect damage from your card effects.
2: Reveal 1 "Ten Thousand Dragon" or "Primal Dragon, the Primordial" in your hand. Add 1 "Ten Thousand Dragon" or "Primal Dragon, the Primordial" from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 Dragon monster with 3000 ATK from your Deck or Extra Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If you control "Ten Thousand Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, you can add 1 card from your Deck to your hand, or play any number of "Primal Dragon, the Primordial" in face-down Defense Position from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Ancient Gear Engineering
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per turn.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except EARTH Machine monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Ancient Gear Golem" or 1 monster that mentions it in your hand and shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 "Ancient Gear" monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: If your opponent activated an effect during your current turn, place 1 "Ancient Gear Duel" from your hand or Deck face-up to your field. You can conduct 2 Normal Summons/Sets this turn, not just 1.

skills.name: Fiendish Gourmet Recipe
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per turn if your Deck contains a total of 12 or more cards that are "Nouvelles" and/or "Recipe" cards.
1: If you control "Poissonniere de Nouvelles", Set 1 "Recipe" card from your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.) Then, you can apply the following effect.
● Shuffle up to 2 Monster Cards from your hand or face-up field into the Deck, then draw the same number of cards.
2: From turn 2 onward, add 1 "Concours de Cuisine (Culinary Confrontation)" from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Full Metarion Script
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are LIGHT Attribute monsters with 500 or 2000 DEF, and if there are 2 or more different Level 10 monsters in your Extra Deck.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT]
●Send 1 "Imaginary Actor" or "Monster Reincarnation" from your Deck to your Graveyard. (Each card once per Duel.)
●Add 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. (Once per Duel.)

skills.name: Indestructible Spright
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except Level 2, Rank 2, Link-2 monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Spright" monster from your hand, then add 1 "Spright" monster with a different Attribute from your Deck to your hand, and add 1 "Spright Elf" from outside your Deck into your Extra Deck. Then, you can shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck.
3: If only your opponent controls a card, choose 2 "Spright" Spell/Trap Cards from your Deck and set 1 to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.) Send the other card to your Graveyard.

skills.name: Master Accel Road
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated by revealing 1 "Sevens Road Magician", "Sevens Road Witch", or "Swordsman of Roadstar" in your hand from turn 2 onward, if all of the Effect Monsters in your constructed Deck are Spellcaster Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 "Sevens Road Magician", "Sevens Road Witch", "Swordsman of Roadstar", and/or"Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. If you added 2 cards to your hand by this effect, also send 1 card from your hand or field to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Master of Blue-Eyes
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 15 or more "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" cards or cards that mention it.
1: Reveal 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your hand and add 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or another card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" and 1 "Black Luster Soldier" from outside your Deck to the Graveyard.
2: If you control a "Blue-Eyes" monster or only your opponent controls a monster, Set 1 Spell/Trap card that mentions "Blue-Eyes White Dragon". (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Red-Eyes Armament
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 15 or more "Red-Eyes" cards and/or "Lord of the Red".
1: Reveal 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", "Lord of the Red", or "Red-Eyes Transmigration" from your hand and add 1 "Lord of the Red" or "Red-Eyes Transmigration" from your Deck to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Red-Eyes" card from your Deck to your hand.
2: If you control a "Red-Eyes" monster, or your opponent controls a monster, add 1 of the 5 monsters from outside your Deck to your hand, send the rest to the Graveyard, then add 1 "Polymerization" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Starlight Drive
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill’s second and third effects once per turn if your Deck contains 7 or more Tuners.
1: Only Synchro Monsters can be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck using this Skill’s first effect.
2: If you control "Stardust Dragon", play 1 "Formula Synchron" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed). Set 1 "Shooting Star" from outside your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)
3: If your opponent has cards in their field or Graveyard, play 1 "Stardust Dragon" from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, send up to 3 random Level 2 monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Starving Venom Invasion
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill’s second and third effects once per
Duel if your Extra Deck contains "Starving Venom Fusion
Dragon".
1: You can only Normal or Special Summon "Predaplant"
monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra
Deck).
2: Reveal 2 cards from your hand, that are "Predap"
cards, "Polymerization” Spell Cards, and/or "Fusion" Spell
Cards, then add 1 "Polymerization" from outside of your
Deck and 1 "Predap" card from your Deck or Graveyard
to your hand.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, place 1
Predator Counter on a face-up monster your opponent
controls, and if you do, any of those monsters that are
Level 2 or higher become Level 1 as long as they have a
Predator Counter.

skills.name: Volcalize Burst Draw
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] If the only monsters in your constructed Deck are FIRE Attribute Pyro/Aqua/Thunder Type monsters, send 2 cards from your hand, including a Level 10 monster, and the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
[EFFECT] Draw 2 cards. If it is turn 2 onward, instead of drawing cards, you can add up to 2 Level 10 monsters from your Graveyard to your hand.

skills.name: Chimera Illusions
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except Beast, Fiend, Illusion, and Spellcaster monsters. 2: Reveal 1 monster that mentions "Chimera Fusion" in your hand and shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 "Chimera Fusion" from your Deck to your hand. Then, you can send 1 Level 7 DARK Illusion or Spellcaster monster with 2500 ATK from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Deck Master: "Dark Magician Girl"
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Dark Magician Girl" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Dark Magician Girl", draw 1 card. If you have monsters in your Graveyard, you can excavate cards from the top of your Deck, up to the number of monsters in your Graveyard. Then, add 1 of those cards to your hand. Shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

skills.name: Deck Master: "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane"
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane", change an Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. Then, halve your opponent's LP. During this rest of this Duel, your opponent will take no effect damage except that of "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane".

skills.name: Giastar F Charge
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Dragon Type monsters and it contains 4 or more DARK Attribute monsters with 2500 ATK.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT]
● Make the original ATK of 1 face-up Level 7 DARK Attribute monster with 2500 ATK on your field become 2800 ATK until the end of this turn.
● For every 1400 ATK from the total ATK of face-up Level 5 or higher monsters your opponent controls, you can add up to any of the following cards ("The Dragon", "Twin Edge Phantom Dragon", "Fusion") from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. ("Twin Edge Phantom Dragon"only once per Duel).

skills.name: Heaven-Sent Skysavior Angel
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, reveal 1 "Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior", "Lua, the Fairy of Skysavior", or "Skysavior Watch" from your hand.
[EFFECT] Send up to 2 cards from your hand or field to the Graveyard, and then draw cards equal to the number of cards you sent to the Graveyard. Then, place 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck.

skills.name: Music Princess's Breath
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Warrior Type monster with 2000 or more DEF in your hand, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are WIND Attribute Warrior Type or WIND Attribute Beast Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Boton the Music Princess" or "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you can Normal Summon/Set Warrior Type monsters with 2000 or more DEF with 1 less Tribute.

skills.name: Power to Weave Hope
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 8 monster from your hand if all of the Level 5 or higher monsters in your constructed Deck are Level 8 LIGHT Attribute monsters with 2500 ATK.
[EFFECT] Make 1 monster on the field lose 900 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can apply the following effects.
●Play up to 2 Level 8 Normal Monsters from your hand to your field.
●If it is turn 2 onward, shuffle 1 monster from your field into your Deck, then play 1 Level 8 monster from your hand.

skills.name: Sun God's Flare
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn, and the third effect once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except Divine-Beast and Aqua monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your hand, then play 1 "Guardian Slime" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, but negate its effects.
3: If you control a Divine-Beast monster or if your opponent controls a monster, make your LP 4100, then add 1 "Monster Reborn" from outside of your Deck to your hand. If you control no cards, you can also add 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" or 1 card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: The King of Fear
skills.desc:
You can only use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Reveal 1 "Visas Starfrost" from your hand, then add 1 "Scareclaw Reichheart" and 1 "Scareclaw Arrival" from your Deck to your hand.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, or you control "Scareclaw Tri-Heart", set 1 "Scareclaw" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Traptrix Territory
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck or those from your opponent's Graveyard or banished cards) any monsters, except EARTH Insect or Plant monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Traptrip Garden" or "Traptrix Holeutea" from your hand and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, selecting from among "Traptrix" monsters as well as "Hole" and/or "Trap Hole" Normal Trap Cards, add a total of 2 cards from your Deck to your hand.
3: During a turn in which your opponent has activated an effect, you can Normal Summon up to 2 times. From turn 2 onward, you can also play 1 "Traptrix" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck.

skills.name: Turbo Destiny Draw
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Twice per Duel if going first, thrice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 WIND Attribute Normal Monster from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

skills.name: Alternation 4
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first effect once per Duel.
1: Reveal 1 Level 4 monster in your hand. Add 1 Level 4 monster with the same Type and Attribute from your Deck to your hand and place the monster you revealed on the bottom of your Deck. Then, draw 1 card. If your opponent controls a monster, this turn, you can also Normal Summon 1 Level 4 monster during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.

skills.name: Crystal Radiance
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 7 different "Crystal Beast" monsters to your Deck. During all of your turns, you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except "Crystal Beast" and "Ultimate Crystal" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Send 2 "Crystal Beast" cards from your hand or face-up field to the Graveyard, then add 2 "Crystal" Spell/Trap Cards from your Deck to your hand, and send 2 "Crystal Beast" monsters from your Deck to your Graveyard.
3: If only your opponent controls a card, reveal 1 Crystal Beast Rainbow Dragon in your hand, then Set 1 "Crystal" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn. )

skills.name: Cybernetic Combat Customization
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from Turn 2 onwardif all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Machine Type and none are Level 7.
[EFFECT] 1 face-up monster on your field
with 1100/2100/2400 ATKgains700ATK until the end of this turn. You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and if you do, add 1 "Proto-Cyber Dragon" or "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Humanity's Trump Card
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1. Can be used before your normal draw. Play 1 "Number 6", "Number 9", "Number 15", "Number 40", or "Number 88" monster, except "Number C" monsters, from your Extra Deck or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, add 1 "Number C" monster with the same number to your Extra Deck. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a "Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force" from your Deck.
2. Reveal 1 Level 4-8 monster or 1 Spell Card from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Dragonic Contact
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second effect once per turn if your Deck contains "Rainbow Dragon".
1: You cannot Special Summon monsters, except "Neos", "Yubel", "Elemental HERO", and "Neo-Spacian" monsters.
2: Send 1 Warrior monster or Level 10 monster from your hand or face-up field to the Graveyard, then play 1 of the following monsters from your Deck or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), and add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck and 1 "Polymerization" from outside of your Deck to your hand.
- "Elemental HERO Neos"
- "Ultimate Crystal" monster
- WIND "Armed Dragon" monster (treated as having been Special Summoned by the effect of an "Armed Dragon" monster)

skills.name: Dyson Sphere Gravity
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck and Extra Deck contain a total of 15 or more monsters that are Level/Rank 9.
1: Activated at the beginning of the Duel. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters from your Extra Deck except those without a Level. In addition to your regular Normal Summon/Set, you can Normal Summon 1 Level 9 monster during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can summon a Level 9 monster without Tributing.
2: If only your opponent controls a monster, shuffle 1 cards from your hand or field into the Deck. Play 1 "Number 9: Dyson Sphere" from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), and attach 2 monsters with different names from outside your Deck to that monster as Xyz Materials. Then, you can add 1 "Xyz" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: EX Code "Infinite Impermanence"
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first effect once per Duel.
1. If you control a monster in your Extra Monster Zone, or if your opponent controls a monster, apply one of the following effects. Then, you can place up to 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Deck. If you do, draw the same number of cards.
●Set 1 "Infinite Impermanence" card from your hand to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.) Then, draw 1 card.
●Set 1 "Infinite Impermanence" card from your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

skills.name: Grandpa's Cards
skills.desc: Begin Duel with the 5 Exodia pieces in your Deck.

skills.name: Guardian Angel's Charity
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains no more than 4 non-LIGHT/non-WIND monsters.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Guardian Angel Joan" and Dragon monsters. You can Normal Summon 1 "Guardian Angel Joan" during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set, and "Guardian Angel Joan" can be Normal Summoned/Set without Tributing, also you can only draw cards by card effects once per turn.
2: Reveal 1 "Luster Dragon #2", "Luster Dragon", or "Guardian Angel Joan" from your hand. Add 1 "Guardian Angel Joan" or Dragon Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 Dragon monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If you control "Guardian Angel Joan", add 1 "Graceful Charity" and 1 "Stamping Destruction" from outside your Deck to your hand, then play up to 1 "Luster Dragon #2" and 1 "Luster Dragon" (up to 2 cards total) from your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Heartbeat of Hope
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's  second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except Xyz Monsters and Level 3-6 monsters.
2: Shuffle 1 "Gagaga" monster or 1 Level 4 monster from your hand into the Deck, then add 2 "Utopia" or "Utopic" monsters with different names to your Extra Deck and play 1 "Gagaga Magician" and 1 "Gagaga Girl" from your hand, Deck, and/or Graveyard. "Gagaga Girl" played by this effect becomes Level 4.
3: If you control "Number 39: Utopia", add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: I Have Nothing to Fear!
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Stardust Dragon" and 1 "Black Rose Dragon" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.) During this Duel, you can only Special Summon Synchro Monsters from your Extra Deck.
2: Reveal 1 Plant monster in your hand. Add 1 "Glow-Up Bulb" from outside your Deck to your hand and draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
3: If you control "Glow-Up Bulb", return 1 card from your hand to your Deck and play 1 "Witch of the Black Rose" and 1 "Rose Fairy" from outside your Deck.

skills.name: Icejade Ripple
skills.desc:
You can use each of this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains 9 or more "Icejade" monsters.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle" from outside your Deck, and send 1 "Icejade" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except WATER monsters.
2: Send 1 WATER monster from your hand to the Graveyard, add 1 "Icejade" monster from your Deck to your hand, or if you sent an "Icejade" monster to the Graveyard, add 1 WATER monster from your Deck to your hand instead.

skills.name: Joan's Guidance
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Summon or Special Summon any monsters, except Fusion Monsters and LIGHT or DARK monsters.
2: During your Main Phase, add 1 "Polymerization", 1 "The Forgiving Maiden", and 1 "Darklord Marie" from outside your Deck to your hand. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except LIGHT Fusion Monsters, until you Fusion Summon a LIGHT Fusion Monster.
3: If you control "St. Joan" or only your opponent controls a monster, draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck.

skills.name: Lilius Contact
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Activated at the beginning of the Duel.
[EFFECT] Add 3 "Excutie Lilius" cards to your Deck and 3 "Excutie Lumière Frontier" cards to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.)

skills.name: Morphtronic Duplication
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except "Morphtronic" monsters, "Gadget" monsters, EARTH Dragon/Machine Synchro Monsters, and Synchro Monsters with 2400 or less ATK.
2: Reveal 1 "Morphtronic Celfon" or "Morphtronic Converter" in your hand, then add 1 "Morphtronic" monster or "Gadget Gamer" from your Deck to your hand. Then, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
3: Send 1 card from your hand or field to the Graveyard, then play up to 2 monsters ("Morphtronic" monsters and/or "Gadget Gamer") from your hand and/or Graveyard face-up. Then, you can decrease the Level of 1 Synchro Monster you control by 1 or 2.

skills.name: Power Engraved in Ancient Memories
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except Dinosaur Type monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Xeno Meteorus" or "Ground Xeno" from your hand and shuffle 1 Level 2 Dinosaur Type monster from your Deck to your hand, then add 4 different Dinosaur Type monsters from outside your Deck to the Extra Deck.
3: Send 1 monster (excluding Effect Monsters) from your Extra Deck to the Graveyard and Set 1 "Supersoaring" from outside your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.) Then, you can banish 1 "Transcendosaurus Meteorus" from your hand or Deck.

skills.name: Predaprime Invasion
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains a total of 3 or more different "Fusion Dragon" monsters.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except DARK Dragon or Plant monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Predaplant" monster from your hand, then add 1 Level 1 or 8 "Predaplant" monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a "Fusion Dragon" monster, or only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 Level 8 or lower "Predaplant" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck. Then, add 1 "Predaprime Fusion" from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Rescue Rabbit Call
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Place up to 2 Level 4 monsters or Normal Monsters from your hand on the bottom of your Deck in any order, then draw the same number of cards. Then, play 1 "Rescue Rabbit" from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Shiranui Style Successor
skills.desc:
At the beginning of the Duel, if your Deck contains at least 10 Zombie Type monsters, add 4 different kinds of "Shiranui" monsters to your Extra Deck, and send 1 "Shiranui Spectralsword" from outside your Deck to your Graveyard. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters with a Level except for FIRE Zombie Type monster. You can use each of the following effects once per Duel.
● Send 1 Level 4 monster from your hand to your Graveyard, and then add 1 "Shiranui" monster from your Deck to your hand.
● Return all of your Synchro Monsters (min. 2 monsters) and Link Monsters that are in the Graveyard or banished to your Extra Deck, and then banish 2 FIRE Zombie Type monsters with different Levels from your Extra Deck. (These monsters can be Special Summoned.)

skills.name: Springans Joining
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except "Fallen of Albaz", "Supreme Sovereign Serpent of Golgonda" LIGHT Spellcaster monsters, "Springans" monsters, Fusion Monsters, and Xyz Monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Fallen of Albaz" or "Springans" Spell/Trap Card in your hand, then send up to 1 "Fallen of Albaz" and up to 1 Level 4 "Springans" monster from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard, and Set 1 "Springans" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.) If "Fallen of Albaz" was sent from your hand to the Graveyard, you can also add 1 "Springans" card from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Starry Slumbering Memories
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters except "Drytron" monsters or Ritual Monsters, or Normal Summon any monsters, except LIGHT monsters.
2: Reveal 1 Level 1 "Drytron" monster from your hand, then add 1 Ritual Monster or "Meteonis Drytron" from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 Level 1 "Drytron" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Drytron" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Supersonic Fusion Enhancement
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" or "Red-Boot Boost Dragon" in your hand from turn 2 onward, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Dragon Type monsters and all of the Level 7 or higher
monsters are "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon" and/or "Red-Boot Boost Dragon".
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Booster Wyvern" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. If you do, also add 1 "Dragons Burst Fusion", "Dragons Boost Fusion", or "Striping Wyvern" from your Deck to your hand. (Each
card once per Duel.)

skills.name: Vaylantz Tactics
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill’s second and third effects once per turn.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters except Pendulum Monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Reveal 1 "Vaylantz" card from your hand and then add 1 "Vaylantz" card that is a different type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your revealed card from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a Level 10 or higher "Vaylantz" monster, or only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 of your "Mamonaka the Vaylantz United" monsters that is in your Extra Deck, Graveyard, or has been banished. If it is turn 2 onward, also shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck.

skills.name: #1: Dueling Is Ramen
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 7 or 8 monster from your hand during a turn in which you have not Fusion Summoned a monster, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are FIRE Attribute Pyro Type monsters, and all of the Level 5 or higher monsters have 0 DEF.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 monsters from your Deck and/or Graveyard to your hand that are either Normal Monsters, "The Noodle Art of Flavor Shift", or "Fusion" cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. This turn, you can only Fusion Summon once.

skills.name: A Bond Illuminates the Future
skills.desc:
Each of the following effects can only be used once per Duel. (You can change the battle position of Set monsters)
● Send 1 "Synchron" monster or 1 Level 2 WIND Warrior-Type monster with 1000 or less ATK from your hand to your Graveyard. Then, add 1 "Synchron" monster from your Deck to your hand and Set 1 "Synchro Chase" from outside of your Deck.
● Send all monsters you control to your Graveyard. If the total of original ATK of the monsters sent to the Graveyard is 2500 or more, Set 2 random Signer Dragons with different names out of 4 from outside of your Deck.
● Can be used turn 3 and onward. Return 1 "Stardust Dragon" from your field/Graveyard to your Extra Deck. Then, change the Level of all Synchro Monsters you control to 2 and Set 1 "Life Stream Dragon" from outside of your Deck.
This Skill can only be used if you begin a Duel with an Extra Deck that contains a Level 10 or higher LIGHT monster and no monsters other than Synchro Monsters, and a Deck that contains at least 7 Level 2 or lower Warrior-Type or Machine-Type monsters.

skills.name: A Burning Roar
skills.desc:
Add 1 "Salamangreat Heatleo" and 1 "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" to your Extra Deck at the beginning of the Duel. 
The following effect can be used once per turn. Until the end of this turn, all monsters on your field gain 100 ATK for each monster on your field.
This Skill can only be used/applied if your Deck/Extra Deck contains 10 or more "Salamangreat" monsters including at least 1 "Salamangreat Heatleo".

skills.name: A Card Entrusted
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 'Fiend's Sanctuary' to your deck.

skills.name: A Cosmic Scourge: Galaxy-Eyes
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon to your Deck. Can be used if you control 2 or more monsters with 2000 ATK or higher. Return 1 Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon from your Graveyard to your hand. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: A Duelist of Your Talent Is What Our Company Needs
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per turn.
1: Apply 1 of the following effects.
●Send 1 Flip monster from your hand to the Graveyard, then play 1 "Tindangle" monster whose Level is lower than it, from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.
●Send 1 "Tindangle" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, then add 1 Flip monster whose Level is lower than it, from your Deck to your hand.
2: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. This turn, all face-down Defense Position monsters you control can change their battle positions and all face-up monsters you control can be used as "Tindangle" monsters for a Link Summon.

skills.name: A Galactic Battle
skills.desc:
Can be used when a "Galaxy-Eyes" Xyz Monster exists on either field.
During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw, send all cards but "Galaxy-Eyes" Xyz Monsters on both fields to the Graveyard.
After using this Skill, this turn will end.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: A New Power!
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 'Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin' to your Deck. Then, add 1 'Elemental HERO Aqua Neos' to your Extra Deck.

skills.name: A Trick up the Sleeve
skills.desc: Your starting hand will include 1 level 7 or higher DARK Spellcaster-Type monster, randomly selected from your Deck. This Skill will not activate if your Deck does not contain any Level 7 DARK Spellcaster-Type monsters. You cannot Special Summon effect monsters during your first turn.

skills.name: ATK Booster: Level 2
skills.desc: Increase the ATK of all level 2 or lower monsters on your side of the field by 200.

skills.name: ATK Booster: Synchro Warriors
skills.desc: Until the end of the turn, 'Warrior' Synchro Monsters on your side of the field will gain 100 ATK times their level. This Skill can only be used once per turn.

skills.name: ATK: 8800 Pulse
skills.desc:
Can only be used if you control exactly 1 Level 4 monster with an ATK equal to its DEF. 
Your monster's ATK becomes 8800, but returns to its original value at the end of the turn. 
 For the rest of the turn after using this Skill, your opponent takes no damage. 
 This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Absolute Ruler of Time
skills.desc:
Can be used when you have a "Number" monster on your field with "107" in its name with Xyz Materials, and there are 4 or more cards in your hand.

Send all Xyz Materials on your field to the Graveyard, and return all cards in your hand and Graveyard to your Deck, except for "Number" monsters on your field with "107" in their name. Afterward, add 4 cards to your hand from the top of your Deck.

This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Accel Counter
skills.desc:
Return 1 card from your hand to the Deck, select 1 "Counter" Counter Trap Card in your Graveyard, and Set it to your field. If you control a FIRE Warrior-Type monster, and your opponent has activated a Counter Trap Card during the Duel, you may select 1 Counter Trap Card instead and Set it to your field. The card you Set with this Skill can also be activated during this turn.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Acceptable Result
skills.desc: For each 'Fortune Fairy' monster you control, add 1 'Unacceptable Result' from your Graveyard to your hand. you can only use this Skill once per Duel.

skills.name: Access Denied
skills.desc:
Can be used from your 5th turn and onward, when you have 1000 or less Life Points. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, neither player can Summon an Effect Monster nor activate the effects of their monsters. 
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Advance Burst Draw (Archive Skill)
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated before your normal draw on turn 4 onward, if your LP is lower than your opponent's and you have no monsters on your field (once per Duel).
[EFFECT] One of the cards from your normal draw will be a random Level 7 or higher Normal Monster with the highest ATK in your Deck. If you activated this Skill on turn 10 or later, you can also add 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from outside of your Deck to the Deck.

skills.name: Afterlife Lockdown
skills.desc:
Can be used when you control a "Cubic" monster. During this turn, opponent monsters destroyed in battle will return to their owner's Deck instead of their Graveyard. 
 This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Air Formula Accelerator
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are WIND Attribute, and all of the Level 4 or higher monsters are "Air Formula Eagle" or Normal Monsters.
[EFFECT] Send 2 "Sky Dragon" cards from outside your Deck to the Graveyard, then add up to 2 monsters from your Deck to your hand that are either Level 7 monsters, "Cyber Falcon", or "Mecha Umbretta" cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand or field to the Graveyard. Then, add 1 "Following World" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. (Once per Duel.)

skills.name: All for the Barian World!
skills.desc:
This Skill's first effect can be used if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 5 or more "Star Seraph" monsters.
 1: Can be used before your normal draw if your opponent controls a card. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Allured by Darkness
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1800. instead of conducting your normal draw, 'Allure of Darkness' is added to your hand from outside of your Deck.

skills.name: Almighty God, the Creator
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" and 1 "Shinato's Ark" to your Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell Card from your Deck.

skills.name: Altergeist Booster
skills.desc: During your turn, the ATK of "Altergeist" monsters on your field is increased by 50 for each "Altergeist" Trap Card in your Graveyard.

skills.name: Altergeist Overwrite
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 9 or more "Altergeist" cards.

1: At the beginning of the Duel, gain 1000 Life Points.

2: From turn 2 onward, shuffle 1 monster from your field into the Deck, and then play 1 "Altergeist Fijialert" from outside of your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Altergeist Preparations
skills.desc:
Can be used before your normal draw each time your Life Points decrease by 1000, if you have 3 or more "Altergeist" Trap Cards in your Deck. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random "Altergeist" Trap Card from your Deck. 
This Skill can be used twice per Duel.

skills.name: Altergeist Trade
skills.desc: Can be used before your normal draw each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. Return 1 "Altergeist" Continuous Trap Card on your field to the Deck. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random "Altergeist" monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Alternative Evolution
skills.desc: Select 1 monster you control with 3000 or more ATK, whose original name is 'Blue-Eyes White Dragon'. The selected monster becomes 'Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon'. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Amnesia Rush
skills.desc:
You can only Special Summon monster(s) whose original Level is 7 once per Duel.
 [REQUIREMENT] Can be activated if your constructed Deck contains no Level 7 or higher Effect Monsters and all of the monsters are LIGHT Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.
 [EFFECT] Send 1 Level 6 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, make up to 2 face-up monsters (1 Level 6 or higher Normal Monster and/or 1 Level 6 Effect Monster) on your field gain 600 ATK until the end of this turn.

skills.name: Amnesia of the Savants
skills.desc: Negate the effects of "D/D Savant Galilei" and "D/D Savant Kepler" in your Pendulum Zones until the Main Phase of your next turn. This skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Ancestral Arts of Gusto
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 3 "Gusto" monsters with different names to your Extra Deck. During all of your turns, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Gusto" monsters and WIND Tuners.
2: Reveal 1 "Gusto" monster in your hand and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, then add up to 2
"Gusto" cards and/or WIND Tuners from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control "Daigusto Sphreez" or your opponent has activated an effect this turn, play 1 "Gusto" monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Ancient Forces
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if the only monsters with 1400 or more ATK in your Deck are Dragon Type.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] 1 face-up Level 6 FIRE or WATER Attribute Dragon Type Effect Monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can send 1 Level 6 WATER or FIRE Attribute Dragon Type monster from your Deck to your Graveyard.

skills.name: Angel Baton
skills.desc: Can only be used on your 4th turn. instead of conducting your normal draw, draw 2 cards and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Anti-Glare Shield
skills.desc:
Until the end of your opponent's next turn, if your opponent's LIGHT monster attacks you, the battle damage you take becomes 0, once only.
This skill can only be used once per duel.

skills.name: Arcana Swap
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, shuffle any number of 'Arcana Force' monsters from your hand into the Deck. Then, draw that same number of cards.

skills.name: Ark of Lost Souls
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK" to your Extra Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if you have 3000 or less LP. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random WATER Fish monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Armed Crossover
skills.desc:
Send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard, then add 1 "LV" monster from your Deck to your hand, and 4 different "Armed Dragon" monsters & 1 "White Veil" to your Deck from outside of your Deck. After doing so, send up to 2 monsters from your hand/Deck to the Graveyard so with a combined Level of 10, and select up to 3 monsters from your Graveyard. As long as the selected monsters remain in the Graveyard, they will be DARK and cannot be used for Fusion Material.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel if you begin the Duel with a Deck (excluding Extra Deck) that contains 10 or more WIND "Armed Dragon" monsters, and no monsters other than "Armed Dragon" monsters or Normal Monsters.

skills.name: Armed Dragon Vortex
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel. 1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Armed Dragon" monsters and WIND Dragon
monsters.
2: Reveal 1 Level 7 WIND Dragon monster. Add 2 "Armed Dragon" monsters with different Levels from your Deck to your hand. Then, play 1 "Armed Dragon" from your hand in face-down Defense Position. (This is treated as a Special Summon by the effect of "Armed Dragon". Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Aroma Strategy
skills.desc: You can look at the card at the very top of your Deck at any time.

skills.name: Assault Archfiend Acceleration
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
