1: You can Normal Summon 1 monster that mentions "Assault Mode Activate" in addition to your Normal Summon/Set, and can activate "Assault Mode Activate" from your hand during your turn, but you cannot Synchro Summon Level 9 or higher Synchro Monsters, except Dragon monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Assault Mode Activate" or 1 card that mentions it in your hand, then shuffle up to 2 cards from your hand into the Deck. Then, draw the same number of cards.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" or 1 "Scarred Dragon Archfiend" from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Assault Star Acceleration
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You can Normal Summon 1 monster that mentions "Assault Mode Activate" in addition to your Normal Summon/Set, and can activate "Assault Mode Activate" from your hand during your turn, but you cannot Synchro Summon Level 9 or higher Synchro Monsters, except Dragon monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Assault Mode Activate" or 1 card that mentions it in your hand, then shuffle up to 2 cards from your hand into the Deck. Then, draw the same number of cards.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Stardust Dragon" or 1 "Junk Archer" from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Attack Burst
skills.desc: Can only be used up until your 3rd turn, and only once. Select 1 monster you control. It gains 500 ATK. At the end of the turn, this monster's ATK will become 0.

skills.name: Attack Charge
skills.desc: 1 face-up monster you control gains the current turn count x100 ATK until the end of the turn. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Attack Mode
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] 1 face-up monster with 0 ATK and 1400 or less DEF on your field gains 1200 ATK and loses 600 DEF.

skills.name: Avaricious Avians
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters,
including a Winged Beast monster, from your Graveyard or banished cards into the Deck. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Bellow
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard and/or banished cards into the Deck, including a Dinosaur monster. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Blessing
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters, including a Fairy monster, from your Graveyard or banished cards into the Deck. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Connection
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard and/or banished cards into the Deck, including a Cyberse monster. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Contract
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard and/or banished cards into the Deck, including a Fiend monster. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Drive
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect once per turn and twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters from your GY and/or banished cards into the Deck, including a Machine monster. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Spellcraft
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters,
including a Spellcaster monster, from your Graveyard or banished cards into the Deck. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avaricious Surface
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect up to twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard and/or banished cards into the Deck, including a Fish monster. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Avenger and Doom Dragon
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 'Infernity Avenger' to your Deck. Then, add 1 'Infernity Doom Dragon' to your Extra Deck.

skills.name: Avenger from the Void
skills.desc: Begin the Duel with 1 'Infernity Avenger' in your Graveyard. This Skill will not activate if you begin the Duel with a Deck that contains monsters other than DARK monsters.

skills.name: Awakened Reincarnation Power
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.

1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 "Salamangreat Pyro Phoenix" to your Extra Deck.

2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random FIRE Cyberse monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Awakening of the Charmers
skills.desc:
Reveal 1 "Charmer" or 1 "Familiar-Possessed" and return 1 card from your Hand to your Deck to set 1 Awakening of the Possessed from outside your Deck. This Skill can only be used once per Duel if you begin the Duel with a Deck containing:
 ● Familiar-Possessed - Aussa
 ● Familiar-Possessed - Eria
 ● Familiar-Possessed - Hiita
 ● Familiar-Possessed - Wynn

skills.name: B.E.S. Rush
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except "B.E.S." monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Send "Boss Rush" or 1 Spell/Trap Card that mentions it from your hand or face-up field to the Graveyard, and then add 1 "B.E.S." monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. If you control no cards in your Field Zone, Set 1 "B.E.F. Zelos" card from your Deck, otherwise draw 1 card or add 1 "Super B.E.S. Metal Slave" card from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Baggy Sleeves
skills.desc: If your Level 7 or higher monster is destroyed by battle, your normal draw in the next Draw Phase becomes 2 cards. This Skill will only activate once per Duel.

skills.name: Balance
skills.desc:
Your starting hand will reflect the card balance of your Deck. This Skill will not activate unless you have at least 6 of each type of card (Monster, Spell, and Trap) in your Deck. 
You cannot Special Summon or activate monster effects until the end of the Main Phase of your first turn.

skills.name: Bandit
skills.desc:
Can be used if your Life Points are at 1500 or below. Return 1 card from your hand to your Deck. Then, select 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone and steal it. 
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Bane of Darkness
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You can Normal Summon "Dark Magician" and "Buster Blader" without Tributing, but you cannot Special Summon Level 2 or higher monsters except for "Buster Blader" monsters and Level 6 or higher DARK Spellcaster monsters and Level 7 or higher DARK Dragon monsters with 2400 or less ATK.
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, reveal 1 "Dark Magician" in your hand, then play 1 "Buster Blader" from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
3: During a turn that you Normal Summoned "Dark Magician", add 1 "Polymerization" and 1 "Diffusion Wave-Motion" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph - Chaos Seraph
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per turn.
1: You can only Normal or Special Summon "Star Seraph" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: During your Main Phase, play "Star Seraph" monsters, 1 each from your Deck and hand to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
3: If there is a card on your opponent's field, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Play 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, add 1 Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force from outside of your Deck to your hand. During this turn, the battle damage of your Number C102: Archfiend Seraph will be doubled.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Destiny Draw: RUM
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Barian
Battlemorph! Regain your true form! You can send 3 Rank 5 "Number C" monsters with different names that have a number "101" or higher in their name from your Extra Deck to your Graveyard, and send 3 monsters with the same names from outside of your Deck to your opponent's Graveyard. Then, play 1 "Number 104: Masquerade" card from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" or "Rank-Up-Magic Admiration of the Thousands".
2: Reveal 1 DARK monster or Spell Card from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Ice Queen
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: If you Xyz Summon "Number 103: Ragnazero" or WATER Winged Beast Xyz Monster(s), you can use 1 Level 5 or lower WATER Winged Beast monster you control as material to Xyz Summon. You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except WATER Winged Beast monsters and Xyz Monsters. During this Duel, monsters your opponent control loses 100 ATK.
2: Reveal 1 Winged Beast monster from your hand. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Add 2 Level 4 WATER Winged Beast monsters from your Deck to your hand and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" from outside your Deck to your hand. If your opponent controls a monster, you can also play 1 Level 4 WATER Winged Beast monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Ragnafinity
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: If you Xyz Summon "Number 103: Ragnazero" or WATER Winged Beast Xyz Monster(s), you can use 1 Level 5 or lower WATER Winged Beast monster you control as material to Xyz Summon. You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except WATER Winged Beast monsters and Xyz Monsters. During this Duel, monsters your opponent control loses 100 ATK.
2: Reveal 1 Winged Beast monster from your hand. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Add 2 Level 4 WATER Winged Beast monsters from your Deck and add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" from outside your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be used before your normal draw. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One" from outside your deck.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Sargasso, the Dark Realm
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, place 1 "Sargasso the D.D. Battlefield" from outside of your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. During this Duel, you can only Normal or Special Summon "Star Seraph" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck and reveal 1 "Sargasso Lighthouse" or "Sargasso the D.D. Battlefield" in your hand. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Add 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck to your hand and play 1 "Star Seraph Sage" from outside of your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Shadows of Deception
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "Sargasso the D.D. Battlefield" from your hand or Deck. If you Set it from your hand, also draw 1 card.
2: Send 1 "Sargasso Lighthouse" from your hand to the Graveyard. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Draw 1 card.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Shooting Star Fist
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except "Battlin' Boxer" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Send 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster from your hand or face-up field to the Graveyard, then play 1 "Battlin' Boxer" monster in face-down Defense Position to your field. (Its battle position can be changed.) If only your opponent controls a card, you can play 2 instead.
3: If you control "Number 105: Battlin' Boxer Star Cestus", Barian Battlemorph and regain your true form! Add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" from outside your Deck to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Counter" Counter Trap Card from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Strongest Barian
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per turn and twice per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except "Umbral Horror" and "Number" monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Glorious Numbers" or 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell Card in your hand, and if you do, add up to 2 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell Cards from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 "Number 104: Masquerade" and 3 Rank 5 "Number C" monsters with different names that has a number "101" or higher in their name from your Extra Deck to your Graveyard, and send 4 monsters with the same name as them from outside of the Deck to your opponent's Graveyard. (These 8 cards can be Special Summoned.)
3: Send 1 card from your field to the Graveyard. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Play 1 "Number" monster from the Graveyard to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! The Barians' White Shield
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn, and the third effect once per Duel.
1: You can only Normal or Special Summon "Star Seraph" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck). Monsters you control that include "Number 102" in the original card name can attack twice in each Battle Phase.
2: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Star Seraph" from your Deck and 1 from your hand in face-down Defense Position. (Their battle positions can be changed.) 3: If there is a card on your opponent's field, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Play 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), then add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! The Power That Guides the World
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains "CXyz Barian Hope".
1. Send 1 "Number" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck to your Graveyard. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Play 1 "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK" from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, Set 1 "Barian Untopia" from outside your Deck to your Field Zone, and add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos" from outside your Deck to your hand. If your opponent controls no monsters, you cannot Special Summon a monster this turn.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph! Twin Destinies
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first effect once per turn.
1: Can be activated during your Main Phase. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! You can play 1 "Number 103: Ragnazero" or "Ice Beast Zerofyne" (each card can only be played once per Duel) in face-down Defense Position from your Extra Deck (its battle position can be changed) and attach 2 "Blizzard Thunderbird" from outside your Deck to that monster as Xyz Material, also until the end of your opponent's turn, monsters your opponent control loses 100 ATK.

skills.name: Barian Battlemorph: Number Over One Hundred
skills.desc:
Can be used on turn 2 and onward if there is exactly 1 Xyz Monster on your field that has a number between "101" and "107" in its original name, except "Number C" monsters.
My True Form! Barian Battlemorph! After transforming to the true form, you can use each of the following effects only once.
 ● Place 1 Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force face-down on your field from outside of your Deck. While "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" that is placed on the field by this Skill is on the field, you can only Normal or Special Summon monsters that have the same Type and Attribute as one of the monsters on your field.
 ● Return all of your banished "Number" monsters and "Number" monsters in your Graveyard to the Extra Deck.

skills.name: Barian's Chaos Draw
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's third effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, all "Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One" cards in your Deck are placed at the bottom of the Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One" from your Deck.
3: During your Main Phase, either place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Baseball Rush Duel
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated by revealing 1 monster with 2000 DEF or 1 "Feverous Spirit Stadium" in your hand from turn 2 onward, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are FIRE Attribute Warrior Type monsters and/or FIRE Attribute Dragon Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 cards (Normal Monsters and/or "Player #39: Home Run Hitter" and/or "Feverous Spirit Stadium") from your Deck to your hand, and send up to 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard. If you sent 2 cards to the Graveyard, this turn, your Level 4 Normal Monsters inflict piercing battle damage.

skills.name: Battle Chronicle
skills.desc:
During this Duel, you can Normal Summon/Set "Chronicle Magician" or a Normal Monster with 2500 ATK or DEF without Tributing, also you cannot Normal or Special Summon an Effect Monster with a Level, except for Spellcaster-Type LIGHT/DARK monsters of Dragon-Type LIGHT monsters.
You can use this once per turn on a turn where "Chronicle Sorceress" or a Level 7 or above monster is Normal or Fusion Summoned. From your Deck, add 1 "Successor Soul" or Quick-Play Spell Card with "Dark Magician" or "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in the Card name to your hand, and send 1 monster to your Graveyard from your Deck/Extra Deck that isn't an Effect Monster, and that doesn't have a monster of the same name in your field or Graveyard.

skills.name: Battle! Ancient Gear
skills.desc:
Each of the following effects can be used once per turn and twice per Duel.
● During this turn, you can Normal Summon/Set "Ancient Gear Golem" or "Ancient Gear Golem - Ultimate Pound" without Tributing. 
● If you control "Ancient Gear Golem," Set 1 "Polymerization" to your field from outside of your Deck. At the End Phase of this turn, return that card to the bottom of the Deck. 
This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck (excluding Extra Deck) that contains at least 12 Level 8 or lower "Ancient Gear" monsters and no monsters other than Level 8 or lower "Ancient Gear" monsters.

skills.name: Bear Parade
skills.desc:
Each of the following effects can be used once per turn and once per Duel by selecting 1 "Frightfur Bear" you control.
 ● Select 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard and equip it to this card as an Equip Card. The card equipped counts as having been equipped by the effect of this "Frightfur Bear." 
 ● During this turn, the selected monster gains an additional attack for each card it has equipped.

skills.name: Beatdown
skills.desc: Until the end of the turn, increase the ATK of all face-up Level 5 or higher monsters you control by the number of Level 5 or higher monsters you control times 300. This Skill can only be use once per Duel.

skills.name: Benkei the Guardian
skills.desc: Select 1 "Superheavy Samurai Big Benkei" you control that is equipped with a "Superheavy Samurai Soul" card. This monster will not be destroyed in battle during your opponent's next turn and your opponent cannot select a monster other than this monster as an attack target. You cannot declare an attack on the turn you use this Skill. This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck that does not contain Spell/Trap Cards. This Skill can be used only once per Duel.

skills.name: Beyond Curiosity
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Activated at the beginning of the Duel if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Cyberse Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Add 3 "Zeptron" and 3 "Peacock Picotron" to your Deck. Then, send as many "Femtron" as possible from your Deck to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Bitrate Burst
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Dragon Type monsters, the only monster in your constructed Deck with 2500 ATK is "Blue-Fang Burst Dragon", and you have a face-up Level 7 LIGHT or DARK Attribute monster with ATK between 2300 and 2500.
[EFFECT] Change 1 monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position. If that monster has 2500 or more DEF, it also loses 800 DEF until the end of this turn.

skills.name: Black Dragon Rising
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if you have at least 7 Level 5 or higher monsters in your Deck.
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated on turn 2 onward by returning 1 card from your hand to the Deck.
[EFFECT] Reveal 1 "Black Dragon's Chick" in your hand, and add 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can decrease the ATK of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field by 400 until the end of the turn. Your Level 7 Effect Monsters cannot attack this turn.

skills.name: Black Rose Gale
skills.desc: Can be used the turn you Special Summoned 'Black Rose Dragon' while you control 'Black Rose Dragon.' Destroy all cards on the field. This Skill will not activate if you begin the Duel with a Deck/Extra Deck that contains monsters other than Plant-Type monsters or 'Rose Dragon' monsters. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Black Skull Rising
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", "Summoned Skull", or "Change Slime - Skull Dragon Mode" from your hand from turn 2 onward if all of the Level 5 or higher monsters in your constructed Deck are "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" and "Showdown Skull Archfiend".
[EFFECT] Add 2 cards from among Level 7 monsters, "Red-Eyes Moon Dragon" and/or "Change Slime - Skull Dragon Mode" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Black Wind to the Top
skills.desc:
Can be used if you begin with an Extra Deck that contains at least 3 "Blackwing" monsters. At the beginning of the Duel, place 1 "Mountain" to your field and add 1 "Black-Winged Dragon" to your Extra Deck, from outside of your Deck. 
In addition, the following effect can be used once per Duel. Select 1 "Black-Winged Dragon" you control and place 1 Black Feather Counter to it.

skills.name: Black and White Contract
skills.desc:
Can be used by sending 1 face-up "Dark Contract" card on your field to the Graveyard, Select 1 effect from the following and apply it to 1 "D/D" monster on your field.
This Skill can be used twice per Duel if you begin the Duel with a Deck/Extra Deck that contains no monsters other than "D/D" monsters
 ● The selected monster will become a Tuner monster.
 ● The selected monster will become a Level 4 monster.
 ● The selected monster will become a Level 8 monster.

skills.name: Blackwing Ignition
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn. 
1: You cannot Special Summon any monsters from your Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Blackwing" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2: If you control "Black-Winged Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, draw 2 cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Blackwing Rising
skills.desc: Until the end of the turn, 1 'Black-Winged Dragon' or 'Blackwing' Synchro Monster on your side of the field will gain 200 ATK times the number of 'Blackwing' monsters on your side of the field. This Skill can only be used once per turn.

skills.name: Blaster's Inferno
skills.desc:
This Skill can only be used if all of the monsters with 1400 or more ATK in your Deck are Dragon monsters, and the Deck contains 1 or less Level 5 or higher non-FIRE Attribute monster.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 6 or higher FIRE Attribute Normal Monster on your field. It gains 600 ATK until the end of the turn. If it was a Level 7 monster, you can add 1 "Dragon's Inferno" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand (twice per Duel).

skills.name: Blasting Borrel
skills.desc:
At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Borreload Dragon" to your Extra Deck.
Can be used if your LP are at 3000 or below. Choose either 1 "Miniborrel Dragon" or 1 "Quadborrel Dragon" and add it to your Extra Deck.
This skill can only be used once per turn and twice per duel.

skills.name: Blaze Accelerator Deployment
skills.desc: Turn 1 'Blaze Accelerator' you control into 'Tri-Blaze Accelerator'. This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Blaze Accelerator Recovery
skills.desc: Return up to 3 'Volcanic' or 'Blaze Accelerator' card(s) from your Graveyard to your Deck. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Blaze Accelerator Reserve
skills.desc: Can be used by sending 1 or 2 'Volcanic' monster(s) from your hand to your Graveyard. Choose 'Blaze Accelerator' card(s) from your Deck or Graveyard equal to the number of cards you sent from your hand to the Graveyard, and add them to your hand. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Blazing Draw
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated before your normal draw from turn 4 onward if your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster or 3 monsters on their field. (Once per Duel.)
[EFFECT] One of the cards from your normal draw will be a random Level 5 or 6 FIRE Attribute non-Legend monster.

skills.name: Blessing of the Cyber Angel
skills.desc: Can be used if your Life Points are at 2000 or below. instead of conducting your normal draw, a 'Cyber Angel' monster of your choice is added to your hand from outside of your Deck.

skills.name: Blisstopian Boon
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Before your normal draw, if your opponent has a face-up Level 5 or higher monster on their field, shuffle a total of 3 Wyrm Type monsters and/or "Peaks of Blisstopia" from your Graveyard into the Deck. (Once per Duel.)
[EFFECT] One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be 1 "Constructor Princess Pylon" or 1 "Peaks of Blisstopia" from your Deck. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 7 or higher monsters, except for Wyrm Type monsters.

skills.name: Blizzard Jet Stream
skills.desc:
Select 1 WATER Winged Beast-Type monster you control. The selected monster gains 1500 ATK until the end of the turn. During this turn, battle damage to your opponent from any battles involving the monster becomes 0.
This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Bloom of Avarice
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters, including a Plant monster, from your Graveyard or banished cards into the Deck. Then, draw 1 card.

skills.name: Blowing Up Yosen
skills.desc: Select 1 "Yosen Training Grounds" you control and place Yosen Counter(s) on it equal to the number of "Yosenju" monsters on your field. This Skill can only be used once per Duel. In addition, add a Pendulum Zone to your field if you began the Duel with a Deck that has 9 or more "Yosenju" monsters. (Extra Deck does not count.)

skills.name: Blue Falcon Formation
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if you have at least 6 Level 5 or higher Normal Monsters with 1400 or more DEF in your Deck, and it contains no Level 4 monsters other than Warrior/Fairy/Winged Beast Type monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during the turn you have Summoned a Level 4 or higher Normal Monster with 1200 or more ATK/1400 or more DEF.
[EFFECT] 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field loses 800 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

skills.name: Blue Medicine Deal
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated once per Duel.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Blue Medicine" from your hand in your Spell & Trap Zone, and draw 1 card.

skills.name: Blue-Eyes Dimension
skills.desc:
During this Duel, if you have at least 9 "Blue-Eyes" monsters in your Deck at the beginning of the Duel, you can Normal Summon/Set Blue-Eyes White Dragon without Tributing, and you cannot Special Summon monsters except LIGHT Dragon-Type monsters with Levels and Ritual Monsters. In addition, the following effect can be used once per Duel.
Send 2 "Blue-Eyes" monsters (1 from your hand and 1 from your Deck) to the Graveyard, add 1 Blue-Eyes White Dragon or Monster Reborn from your Deck to your hand, and place 1 Polymerization from outside of your Deck at the bottom of your Deck. If you activated this Skill on turn 2 or later, also place 1 Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon and 1 Chaos Form at the bottom of your Deck.

skills.name: Blue-Eyes Reign
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if your Deck contains 7 or more Level 5 or higher monsters and no Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monsters with 1900 DEF or lower.
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, if there are no face-up Level 8 or higher monsters on your field, shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck and reveal 1 "Kaibaman" in your hand.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Blue-Eyes Bright Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Bluff Trap
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1200. 'Statue of the Wicked' is set in your Spell & Trap Zone.

skills.name: Boogie Master Draw
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if you have at least 10 LIGHT Attribute Aqua Type monsters in your Deck.
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated before your normal draw on turn 4 onward, if your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster and you have no monsters on your field (once per Duel).
[EFFECT] Two of the cards from your normal draw will be "Dian Keto the Boogie Master" and "Seahorse Carrier."

skills.name: Born from the Earth
skills.desc:
Can be used if you control a 'Dark Magician' and your Life Points are at 2000 or below.
Place 1 'Metamorphortress' face-down on your side of the field.
If your opponent controls a Dragon-Type monster with 3000 ATK or more, you can use this Skill regardless of your Life Points. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Borrel Booster
skills.desc: If you control a "Borrel" monster, your "Borrel" and "Rokket" monsters will gain 200 ATK.

skills.name: Borrel Launch
skills.desc:
This Skill is applied only once a Duel at the beginning of your turn after Turn 4. Send 1 "Dillingerous Dragon" from outside of your Deck to your Graveyard.
In addition, the following effect can be used once per Duel if you control a "Rokket" monster. Set 1 "Boot Sector Launch" from your Deck to your field. During this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters except DARK monsters.
This Skill can only be used/applied if you begin the Duel with a Deck that follows the conditions below:
● Your Deck (excluding Extra Deck) contains at least 9 "Rokket" monsters.
● Your Extra Deck contains "Borreload Dragon."

skills.name: Borreload Detonation
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Mirror Force" from outside your Deck to your hand.
2: If you control "Borreload Dragon" or your opponent controls a monster, play 1 Level 4 or lower DARK Dragon monster from your hand or Graveyard in face-up position.

skills.name: Borreload Link
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During this Duel, you can Normal Summon/Set monsters whose sum of ATK and DEF equals 4000 without Tributing, but you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except DARK Cyberse or DARK Dragon monsters.
2: Reveal 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon monster in your hand, and then send 2 Level 7 or higher Dragon monsters from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard, and add 1 monster whose sum of ATK and DEF equals 4000 from your Deck to your hand. This turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Link Monsters.
3: If a monster is on your opponent's field or in their Graveyard, play 1 Link-2 "Borrel" monster from your Extra Deck to your field.

skills.name: Branded Journey
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal Summon any monsters, except "Fallen of Albaz" and LIGHT Spellcaster monsters with 1500 ATK.
2: Reveal 1 "Fallen of Albaz", 1 Dragon monster that mentions it, or 1 "Dogmatika" card in your hand, shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then send 1 "Fallen of Albaz" and 1 monster that mentions it from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Albion the Shrouded Dragon" or 1 "Branded in White" from your Deck to your hand.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Branded Bond" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Bright Adjuster
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, you can make 1 monster you control become a Level between 1 and 5 until the end of this turn. This turn, as long as that monster remains face-up on your field, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except Synchro Monsters.

skills.name: Bring it!
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. Return 1 card from your hand to your Deck; then, add 1 Level 8 DARK Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Building a Diorama
skills.desc:
Can be used during a Duel where you have Ritual Summoned a Ritual Monster whose original Level is 8 or higher. Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. Then, return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of your Deck.

This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck that contains at least 4 Ritual Monsters and 4 Ritual Spell Cards. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Buildragon Draw
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if your Deck contains 5 or more Level 5 or higher monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] Before your normal draw if there is a face-up Field Spell Card on the field.
[EFFECT] One of the cards from your normal draw will be 1 "Constructor Wyrm Buildragon" from your Deck. You cannot activate this Skill during your next turn.

skills.name: Burning Awakening
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.

1: At the beginning of the Duel, randomly select 1 each of Link-1/Link-2/Link-3 "Salamangreat" Link Monsters from your Extra Deck and add 2 copies of each to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except FIRE Cyberse monsters.

2: From turn 2 onward, you can pay LP so that you only have 100 left, then draw 1 card. If it is turn 4 onward, you can instead draw 1 card for each 1000 LP you paid.

skills.name: Burning Draw
skills.desc:
Can be used from your 5th turn and onward, when you have 2300 or less Life Points. Pay Life Points to make your Life Points equal to 100, and add a card to your hand from the top of your Deck for each 1000 Life Points you paid. 

This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck (excluding Extra Deck) that contains at least 10 "Salamangreat" cards. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Burning Soul
skills.desc:
Can be used if you only control 1 DARK Dragon-Type Synchro Monster with 3000 or more ATK. Return 1 card from your hand to your Deck and play 1 Level 4 or lower Tuner monster from your Graveyard in Defense  Position, but negate its effects.

If the monster you control is "Red Dragon Archfiend", you can select up to  2 monsters to play when using  this Skill. Monster(s) played with this Skill cannot be Tributed, and during the turn you use this Skill, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monster except Synchro Monsters that list a Synchro Monster as material.

This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck that contains no Tuner monsters other than "Resonator" monsters. (Extra Deck does not count). This Skill can be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Buzz On
skills.desc: Can be used before your normal draw each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random Insect-Type monster in your Deck.

skills.name: Call from the Dark
skills.desc:
Can be used if the only monster on your field is 1 "Elemental HERO" monster. Banish that monster and play 1 "Evil HERO" Fusion Monster that uses the banished monster as its Fusion Material.

You cannot Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this Skill.

This Skill can only be used once, and only if you begin the Duel with a Deck / Extra Deck that contains no monsters other than "Elemental HERO" or "Evil HERO" monsters.

skills.name: Call of the Magician Girls
skills.desc: If you have 4 or more 'Magician Girl' monsters with different names in your Deck, you will have an improved chance of having a 'Magician Girl' monster in your starting hand.

skills.name: Can't You Reduce My LP?
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's second effect once per turn and twice per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, if your Extra Deck contains "Sunavalon Dryatrentiay", add 5 types of "Sunavalon" monsters and 3 types of "Sunvine" monsters to your Extra Deck, and gain 1200 LP.
2: During a turn you have Normal or Special Summoned either a "Sunseed", "Sunvine", or "Sunavalon" monster, gain 1200 LP.

skills.name: Captivating Bird Call
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, if your Extra Deck does not contain "Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale", add 1 "Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale" to your Extra Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random Level 1 Winged Beast monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Card Shuffle
skills.desc: Can be used by paying 300 Life Points. Shuffle your Deck. This Skill can only be used once per turn.

skills.name: Card of Origin: Z-ONE
skills.desc: 1: Activates at the beginning of your first turn. Set 1 "Z-ONE" from outside of your Deck to your field, but you cannot activate the effect of "Z-ONE" this turn.

skills.name: Card of Sanctity
skills.desc: Can be used at the end of your turn, if you Normal Summoned 'Slifer the Sky Dragon' that turn. Both players draw until they have 6 cards in their hands.

skills.name: Cards of the Swords of Protection
skills.desc:
You can use any of the following effects once in a Duel.
Send 1 Swords of Revealing Light from your field that has been activated during this turn to the Graveyard and draw 1 card.
You can send 1 Swords of Revealing Light from your field to the Graveyard before your normal draw. Your normal draw from this turn will be 1 card that you have chosen from your Deck.

skills.name: Castle of Machines
skills.desc: Return 1 "Meklord" monster in your hand to its owner's Deck and add 1 "Meklord Fortress" to your hand from outside of your Deck. This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Celestial Guidance
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] This Skill can be used if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are LIGHT, DARK, EARTH, and/or WIND Attribute Warrior and/or Fairy Type monsters. 
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT] 
- Make up to 2 face-up monsters on your field with 0 ATK gain ATK equal to [the respective monster's DEF +100] until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can Set 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your Spell & Trap Zone. 
- Make the original DEF of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field become 800 until the end of this turn.

skills.name: Chain Reaction
skills.desc: Your opponent loses 200 Life Points every time you activate a Trap Card.

skills.name: Chain of Ice
skills.desc:
Play 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set from your hand in Defense Position, but its effects are negated. During the turn you use this Skill, you cannot Special Summon any monsters except Xyz Monsters.

This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck/Extra Deck that contains at least 1 monster and no monsters other than WATER monsters. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Chaos Burst-Ray
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you Normal Summoned "Voidvelg Requiem".
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field. This turn, that monster becomes LIGHT Attribute.

skills.name: Chaos-Purifying Waterfall
skills.desc:
You can use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per turn and twice per Duel. 
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters with a Level, except for Fish monsters. 
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then play 1 Level 3, 4, or 5 Fish monster in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), and add 1 Fish monster from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 "Panther Shark" and 1 "Eagle Shark" from outside of your Deck to the Graveyard. 
3: If you control "Number 73: Abyss Splash" or only your opponent controls a monster, take 1 "Xyz" Spell Trap Card or 1 "Mystical Space Typhoon" from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or send it to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Cheater's Coin
skills.desc: If your Life Points are at least 1000 more than opponent's, and if you have at least 5 cards in your hand, your coin tosses always land on heads.

skills.name: Check Out My Fusion!
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1500. Return 1 card from your hand to your Deck and add 'Vehicroid Connection Zone' to your hand from outside of your Deck. This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Check Out My Ride!
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. In the Draw Phase, instead of doing a normal draw, draw a 'roid' monster of your choice.

skills.name: Cheer Up Fairies
skills.desc:
Can be used if your Life Points are at 3000 or below. Place 1 'Fairy Cheer Girl' from your Extra Deck on top of 1 'Little Fairy' you control. (This will be treated as an Xyz Summon.)
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Chemicalized Blast
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you Normal Summoned "Chemicalized Salamander".
[EFFECT] Send 1 "Dr. Red Robe" and 1 "Flame Seeker" from outside of your Deck to the Graveyard.

skills.name: Chivalrous Celerity
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward if all of the monsters with 1600 or more ATK in your constructed Deck and Extra Deck are monsters with 2300/2600 ATK and 2100 DEF and/or Level 5 or lower Dragon Type Normal Monsters.
[EFFECT] Send 1 Level 5 or 7 Normal Monster from your Deck to your Graveyard and make 1 face-up Level 5 or 7 monster on your field gain 300 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 Normal Monster and 1 "Polymerization" from your Graveyard to your hand. (Once per Duel.)

skills.name: Chronomaly Resonance
skills.desc: Return 1 "Chronomaly" monster on your field to your hand and play 1 "Chronomaly" monster with a Level higher than the monster you returned. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Clear Wing Acceleration
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel. You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters except for Synchro Monsters or WIND
Dragon or WIND Machine monsters during the Duel you activate this Skill.
1: If you control "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon", play 1 "Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice" from your Deck or Graveyard.
2: During your Main Phase, send 1 Synchro Monster or 1 "Speedroid" Tuner from your Deck or field to the Graveyard.
If you sent a Synchro Monster to the Graveyard, play 1 "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon" from your Graveyard. That monster gains ATK equal to the Level of the Synchro Monster x 200 until the end of this turn.

skills.name: Climax Beat
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if the only monsters in your Deck are Psychic Type monsters with 2400 or less ATK.
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during the turn on turn 2 onward when you have Normal Summoned a Level 2 monster.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Climax Finale" or "Lullabind" from your Deck or Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone. If your LP are 1000 or lower, you can gain 1000 LP.

skills.name: Clock of Destiny
skills.desc:
Each of the following effects can be used once per Duel.
 ● Send 1 Level 4 or lower "Destiny HERO" monster in your hand to the Graveyard. Then, add 1 "Clock Tower Prison" from your Deck to your Hand.
 ● Select 1 "Clock Tower Prison" in your Field Zone and place 3 Clock Counters on it. Then, you can add "Mystical Space Typhoon" to your hand from your Deck. Return the "Clock Tower Prison" to your Deck at the end of your next turn.
This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck that contains 8 or more "Destiny HERO" monsters and no monster other than "Destiny HERO" or "Elemental HERO" monsters.(Extra Deck is not included.)

skills.name: Code Extended
skills.desc:
Select 1 Link 3 "Code Talker" Link Monster you control and change it to "Decode Talker Extended."
If you select "Decode Talker" in your Extra Monster Zone, you can also select 1 opponent monster and move that target to their Main Monster Zone in the same column as the monster you have selected. 
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Code Talker Alive
skills.desc:
Can be used if you have "Decode Talker" in your Extra Monster Zone. Set 1 "Recoded Alive" to your field from outside of your Deck. 
This Skill can only be used once per Duel if you begin the Duel with a Deck that follows the conditions below:
●Your Deck contains at least 12 Cyberse monsters or "Cynet" Spell/Trap Cards.
●All monsters in your Extra Deck have different card names.

skills.name: Cointech Breakthrough
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you tossed a coin, if all of the monsters with 1400 or more ATK in your constructed Deck are EARTH Attribute Machine Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster on your field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn. If that monster was in face-up Defense Position, change it to face-up Attack Position and switch its original ATK and original DEF until the end of this turn.

skills.name: Command of the Doom King
skills.desc:
At the beginning of the Duel, add Pendulum Zones to your field. 
The following effect can be used once per Duel. Select 1 "D/D/D Doom King Armageddon" from your hand and add, it to your Extra Deck face-up. 
Then, select up to 1 "D/D" Pendulum Monster from your field and Deck respectively, and place it (them) to your Pendulum Zone(s). Then, negate the effect of these cards until the end of your next turn. 
This Skill can only activate and be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck (excluding Extra Deck) that contains at least 5 "D/D/D" Pendulum Monsters.

skills.name: Compensation
skills.desc:
Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. Send the card on the top of your Deck to the Graveyard, and recover 300 LP.
This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Constellar Union
skills.desc:
Reveal 1 "Constellar" monster in your hand to your opponent and send 2 "Constellar" monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard. If you Xyz Summon a "Constellar" monster during this Duel, you can treat it as a Level 3-6 "Constellar" monster and if you Normal Summon/Set a "Constellar" monster, the required Tribute is not needed. You can only Special Summon "Constellar" monsters while you are using this Skill (excluding Special Summons from your Extra Deck).
This Skill can only be used once in a Duel.

skills.name: Construct Blisstopia
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if all of the monsters with 1200 or more ATK in your Deck are Wyrm Type.
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward.
[EFFECT] Choose from your field, 1 face-up Normal Monster (except a Level 4 monster) or 1 "Constructor Wyrm Buildragon". The chosen monster gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. If that monster was "Constructor Princess Pylon", you can also shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and if you do, add 1 "Peaks of Blisstopia" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

skills.name: Contract Door
skills.desc: Can be used if your Life Points are at 2000 or below. Add 1 'Magical Contract Door' to your hand from outside of your Deck. Then, add 1 'Monster Reborn' to your Opponent's hand. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Contract Procrastination
skills.desc: Can be used at the beginning of your turn if you have 1 or more "Dark Contract" card on your field. Skip the Standby Phase of this turn. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Contract: Fabled
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn and twice per Duel, and the third effect once per Duel.

1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) monsters except for "Fabled" monsters.

2: Send 1 monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard, and then add 1 "Fabled" card from your Graveyard to your hand.

3: Shuffle 1 "Fabled" card from your hand into the Deck, and then add 1 "Fabled" card from your Deck to your hand. During your Main Phase this turn, you can Normal Summon 1 "Fabled Grimro" in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.

skills.name: Cosmic Enlightenment
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. In the Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw, draw a random Psychic-Type or 'Jinzo' monster.

skills.name: Courage and Strength
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 'Morphtronic Remoten' to your Deck. Then, add 1 'Power Tool Dragon' to your Extra Deck.

skills.name: Creator
skills.desc: Can be used if your Life Points are at 2000 or below. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw, a powerful card is added to your hand from outside of your Deck. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Creatures of Calamity
skills.desc:
Can be used on turn 3 and onward. Reveal 1 "Frightfur", Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and then send up to 2 Fusion Materials with different names that are listed on its card to your Graveyard. 

During the turn you use this Skill, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters except "Frightfur" monsters, nor activate the monster effects of monsters other than Fusion Monsters. 

This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Crest Deployment
skills.desc: Roll a die. If the result is less than the current turn count, play 1 'Orgoth the Relentless' from your hand. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Crush the World with the Mighty Fist!
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Fire Hand" and 1 "Ice Hand" to your Deck, unless it already includes a copy of the respective card. Then, add 1 "Number 106: Giant Hand" to your Extra Deck. The following effect can be used if your Life Points are at 2000 or below. Return 1 card from your hand to your Deck, and add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" to your hand from outside of your Deck. This skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Crystal Clear Wing Acceleration
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel. 
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except "Clear Wing", "Synchro Dragon", and "Speedroid" monsters. 
2: Send 2 cards from your hand and/or field to the Graveyard, then play 1 "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon" from your Extra Deck or Graveyard. 
3: If you control a Level 10 monster or only your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Speedroid" card or 1 "Speed Recovery" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. If it is turn 2 onward, also send 5 different "Speedroid" monsters from outside of your Deck to the Graveyard. (These cards can be Special Summoned.)

skills.name: Crystal Power
skills.desc: This turn, the ATK of all face-up monsters on your side of the field increases by the number of Continuous Spell Cards on your side of the field times 200. This Skill can only be used once per turn.

skills.name: Cubic Dimension Summon
skills.desc:
Send 1 'Cubic' monster you control to the Graveyard, and play 1 'Cubic' monster from your hand that is 1 Level higher than the monster you send to the Graveyard.
The ATK of the monster you played with this Skill is equal to its original Level x 500.
This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Cubic Seeds
skills.desc:
At the beginning of the Duel, add 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" to your Deck. 
 This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with a Deck/Extra Deck that contains no monsters other than "Cubic" monsters. In addition, the number of Spell/Trap Cards that are not "Cubic" cards must be 6 or lower.

skills.name: Cure Master Dian Keto
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated if your LP are lower than your opponent's (once per Duel). Shuffle 2 Aqua Type monsters with different names from your Graveyard into the Deck
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Dian Keto the Cure Master" from outside of your Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone.

skills.name: Curse of the Dark
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if the only Level 4 or higher monsters in your Deck are all either Dragon Type Normal Monsters or "Multistrike Dragon Dragias."
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] 1 face-up DARK Attribute Normal Monster on your field that was Summoned this turn gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have selected "Dragon Knight of Darkness," you can return 1  card from your hand to your Deck. If you do so, it gains 700 ATK as long as it stays face-up.

skills.name: Curse of the Remnant
skills.desc: When a monster is equipped with a 'The Mask of Remnants' that you control, that monster gains 1000 ATK.

skills.name: Cyber Energy Amplified
skills.desc: When 'Amplifier' is equipped to a monster, increase that monster's ATK by 500. Once per turn, increase the Equipped monster's ATK by 300 for each Equip Spell Card Equipped to it.

skills.name: Cyber Style
skills.desc:
Can be used only once if your Life Points are at 2000 or below. For every 1000 Life Points below 4000, play 1 "Cyber Dragon" with O ATK from your hand or Deck to the field. 
You can only Special Summon "Cyber End Dragon" until the end of your opponent's next turn. "Cyber Dragon" played with this Skill cannot be Tributed, and while they are face-up on the field, you cannot Special Summon except for Fusion monsters, nor attack except with Fusion Monsters.

skills.name: Cyber Style Evolution
skills.desc:
At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Cyber Emergency" and "Power Bond" to the bottom of your Deck.

In addition, the following effect can be used twice per turn and thrice per Duel. 
Select 1 "Cyber Dragon" on your field and change its Level to 5.

This Skill will only activate if you begin the Duel with a Deck that has 12 or more Dragon-Type or Machine-Type "Cyber" monsters. (Extra Deck does not count).

skills.name: Cyber Style Successor
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Cyber End Dragon" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Cyberdark Style
skills.desc: Can be used each time your Life Points decrease by 1000. Return 1 card from your hand to your Deck; then, randomly add 1 'Cyberdark' monster from your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Cynet Conversion
skills.desc:
Can be used if your Life Points are at 2500 or below.
Send 1 Cyberse monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and add 1 "Cynet" Spell/Trap Card from the Deck to your hand. 
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Cynet Extended
skills.desc:
You can use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains 5 or more "Code Talker" monsters with different names.
1: Link Monsters on your field gain 500 ATK, and you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Cyberse Link Monsters.
2: Can be activated by revealing 1 Level 3 or lower Cyberse monster or 1 "Cynet Codec" in your hand, and shuffling 1 card from your hand to the Deck. Add up to 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, choosing from "Cyberse Gadget" and "Cynet" Spell/Trap Cards. 
3: Can be activated if you control "Decode Talker", or if your opponent controls a monster. Play 1 "Code Talker" monster from your Extra Deck, and add 1 "Cynet Crosswipe" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: D.D. King
skills.desc:
All "D/D/D" monsters you control gain 500 ATK until the end of the turn. This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.
If you begin the Duel with a Deck/Extra Deck containing a total of 12 or more "D/D/D" monsters or "Dark Contract" Spell/Trap Cards, add Pendulum Zones to your field at the beginning of the Duel.

skills.name: DARK as Night
skills.desc: Can be used after your Life Points are at 2000 or below. Play the Field Spell 'Mystic Plasma Zone.' If there already is Field Spell on your side of the Field, return it to your hand. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Dangerous Exploration
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you Normal or Special Summoned "Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut".
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Destructor Soldier Helmet" or 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

skills.name: Dark Adjuster
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, you can make 1 monster you control become a Level between 1 and 5 until the end of this turn. This turn, as long as that monster remains face-up on your field, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except Xyz Monsters.

skills.name: Dark Arts of Celerity
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if the only monsters with 1400 or more ATK in your Deck are Warrior Type.
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during the turn you have Summoned a Level 6 or higher DARK/EARTH Attribute Warrior Type monster.
[EFFECT] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

skills.name: Dark Arts of Positioning
skills.desc:
This Skill can only be used if all of the Level 4 or higher monsters in your Deck are Warrior and/or Fairy monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and reveal 1 Level 6 Fairy monster with 0 ATK in your hand.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Semeruler the Dark Summoner" from your Deck to your hand. This turn, at the start of the Battle Phase and during the End Phase, change the battle positions of all face-up Level 6 Fairy monsters on your field.

skills.name: Dark Call Draw
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated before your normal draw from turn 4 onward if your opponent has a face-up Level 7 or higher monster or 3 monsters on their field. (Once per Duel.)
[EFFECT] One of the cards from your normal draw will be a random Level 5 or 6 DARK Attribute non-Legend monster.

skills.name: Dark Fusion
skills.desc: Change 1 "Polymerization" in your hand to "Dark Fusion". This Skill can only be used if you begin the Duel with an Extra Deck that contains no monsters other than "Elemental HERO" or "Evil HERO" monsters. This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel.

skills.name: Dark Gaiastrike
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if all of the monsters with 1300 or more ATK in your Deck are Dragon Type monsters, and your Deck contains at most 1 LIGHT Attribute Level 6 or higher monster.
[REQUIREMENT] During a turn you have Normal Summoned "Illusion Strike Dragon Miragias" or "Steel Strike Dragon Metagias".
[EFFECT] Choose 1 DARK Attribute monster with 2500 ATK from your Deck and add it to your hand. Until the end of your next turn, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent by your Level 7 DARK Attribute monsters is halved.

skills.name: Dark Grudge
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Dark Necrofear" to your Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random DARK Fiend monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Dark Horizon
skills.desc:
If you take a total of 2000 or more damage, you can use this Skill on your next turn.
Play 1 'Dark Magician Girl' from your Deck.
If you took 2500 or more damage on your previous turn, you can play 1 'Dark Magician' from your Deck instead.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Dark Order: "Book of Moon"
skills.desc:
You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel (1 effect per turn) 
1: Reveal 1 DARK monster in your hand, then shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck and add 1 "Book of Moon" from your Deck to your hand.
2: Reveal 1 "Book of Moon" from your hand on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card.

skills.name: Dark Transmission
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Place 1 DARK Attribute Normal Monster from your Graveyard on the top of the Deck. You cannot activate this Skill during your next turn.

skills.name: Dark Tuning 100
skills.desc: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 'Infernity Avenger' to your Deck. Then add 1 'Hundred Eyes Dragon' to your Extra deck.

skills.name: Darkfluid Link
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except Cyberse monsters.
2: If your Extra Deck contains a Link-5 monster, reveal 1 "Firewall" monster or Ritual Monster in your hand, and then banish 5 monsters from outside of your Deck (these monsters can be Special Summoned) and add 1 "Cynet" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. If you activated this effect on the 2nd turn onward, also add 1 "Cynet Rollback" from outside of your Deck to your hand.
3: If you have Special Summoned "Decode Talker" during this Duel, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Graveyard and/or among your banished cards into the Deck.

skills.name: Darkness Returns
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 "Dragon Knight of Darkness", "Evil Dragon of Darkness", or "Shadowbringer Dragon" from your hand if all of the Level 7 or higher monsters in your constructed Deck are LIGHT, DARK, or EARTH Attribute Dragon Type with 2000 or more ATK.
[EFFECT] Reveal 1 DARK Attribute High Dragon Type monster from your Extra Deck. Then, add 1 monster with a card name listed on it as material from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. If you do, add 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

skills.name: Darkstar Sign
skills.desc:
You can only Fusion Summon once per Duel. 
[REQUIREMENT] Twice per Duel. 
[EFFECT] Reveal 1 DARK Attribute Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, and the original ATK of 1 face-up monster on your field whose name is specifically listed as material on that Fusion Monster becomes 1600 until the end of the turn. Then, you can add 1 "Fusion" from outside of your Deck to your hand (once per Duel).

skills.name: Daybreak Order
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if the only monsters in your Deck are Level 7 or lower Spellcaster Type or Warrior Type.
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated if you return 1 card from your hand to your Deck from your second turn onwards.
[EFFECT] Reveal 1 Level 5 or 7 LIGHT Attribute monster to your opponent, and add 1 Level 5 LIGHT Attribute monster or "Raidacross, Hero of the Dawn" from your Deck to your hand. Then, you can add 1 "Rightful Magic" from your Deck to your hand (once per Duel).

skills.name: Death Doom Requiem
skills.desc:
This Skill can be used if the only monsters (except Level 4 monsters) in your Deck are Fiend Type.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Place up to 2 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type Effect Monsters in your hand on your field in face-up Defense Position. (There can only be one of each Level.) While a monster placed on the field with this effect is face-up, its battle position can only be changed with a card effect. This turn, you cannot attack directly using a monster with 2600 or more ATK.

skills.name: Deck Master Effect: Cyber Commander
skills.desc:
If you have 'Cyber Commander' on your field, the ATK/DEF of Warrior-Type and Machine-Type monsters you control incereses by 300. 
In addition, instead of conducting your normal draw, you can add 'Cyber Commander' to your hand from your Deck.

skills.name: Deck Master Effect: Strike Ninja
skills.desc:
When your Life points are at 1500 or below, the following effects can be used once per Duel each.
 ● Send 1 'Ninja' or 'Ninjitsu Art' card from your hand to your Graveyard. Then, select 1 set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone and take control of it.
 ● Select 1 card that you are not the original owner of and banish it. Then, play 1 'Strike Ninja' from outside of your Deck.

skills.name: Deck Master: "Goddess with the Third Eye"
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Goddess with the Third Eye" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Goddess with the Third Eye", send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard, then add 1 "Polymerization" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Deck Master: "Kaiser Sea Horse"
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Kaiser Sea Horse" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Kaiser Sea Horse", you can Normal Summon a LIGHT monster with 1 less Tribute this turn.

skills.name: Deck Master: "Kuriboh"
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, banish 1 "Kuriboh" from outside your Deck.
2: If the total ATK of all monsters your opponent controls is equal to or higher than your LP at the start of your opponent's Battle Phase, play 1 of your banished "Kuriboh" monsters. Monsters played using this effect cannot be destroyed in battle during this turn (once per turn).

skills.name: Deck of Dormant Divinity
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel. 1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" to your Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at
3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this
turn will be a random DIVINE Divine-Beast monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Decoy Tactics
skills.desc: Can be used when your Life Points decrease by 1500. Play 1 'Decoy Dragon' from outside your deck in Defense Position. You cannot Special Summon any other monsters during the turn you activate this Skill. This Skill will only activate if you begin the Duel with a Deck that has 5 or more Dragon-Type monsters with different names. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Defense Burst
skills.desc: Can only be used up until your 3rd turn, and only once. Select 1 monster you control. It gains 500 DEF until the end of your opponent's turn. At the start of your next turn, this monster's DEF will become 0.

skills.name: Defense Charge
skills.desc: 1 face-up monster you control gain the current turn count x200 DEF until the end of the turn. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Defensive Hand
skills.desc:
Can be used when you control one of the following monsters. During this turn, you take no effect damage.
● Magic Hand
● Fire Hand
● Ice Hand
● Prominence Hand
● Number 106: Giant Hand
This Skill can only be used once per turn and thrice per Duel.

skills.name: Demolisher's Resonance
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward, if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Dragon Type monsters and it contains 4 or more Level 7 EARTH Attribute monsters.
[EFFECT] 1 face-up monster on the field loses 400 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. Then, you can send 1 ""Dragonic Slayer" from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard. (Once per Duel.) If you sent it to the Graveyard, also add 1 "Dragonic Scout" from outside your Deck to your hand.

skills.name: Demon's Resonance
skills.desc:
Return 1 "Resonator" monster from your hand to the Deck, add 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend-Type monster from your Deck to your hand, and add 1 "Red Rising Dragon" to your Extra Deck from outside of your Deck. During this turn, you cannot use the effects of cards you have added to your hand with this Skill or cards with the same name. 
This Skill can only be used once per turn and twice per Duel if you begin the Duel with a Deck that follows the conditions below:
● Your Deck contains at least 8 "Resonator" cards and does not contain any monsters other than Dragon-Type or Fiend-Type monsters. 
● Your Extra Deck contains "Red Dragon Archfiend" and "Red Nova Dragon" and does not contain any monsters other than Synchro Monsters.

skills.name: Descent of the Star Seraph
skills.desc:
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Number 102: Star Seraph Sentry" to your Extra Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random Level 4 LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck.

skills.name: Destiny Board
skills.desc: Can be used if 'Dark Necrofear' is in your Graveyard, and your Life Points are at 2000 or below. At the end of your fifth turn after activating this Skill, you win the Duel. This Skill is negated if 'Dark Necrofear' leaves your Graveyard. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Destiny Calling
skills.desc: Can be used after your Life Points are at 3000 or below. Play the Field Spell 'Dark City.' If there already is Field Spell on your side of the Field, return it to your hand. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Destiny Draw
skills.desc: Can be used when your Life Points decrease by 2000. In the Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw, draw a card of your choice. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Destiny Draw Leading to Dragon Master Knight
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1. Can be used before your normal draw. Play 1
"Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position, and send 1 "Black Luster Soldier" from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be 1 "Ultimate Fusion" from your Deck.
2: Reveal 1 LIGHT, DARK, or EARTH monster, or 1 "Ultimate Fusion" from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw of the One Marked by the Dragon
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Play 1 "Crimson Dragon" from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Your normal draw this turn will be 1 card from your Deck that mentions "Crimson Dragon", and for the rest of the Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters from your Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.
2: During your Main Phase, return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Blue-Eyed Dragons
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Set 1 "Burst Stream of Destruction" from outside your Deck. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Blue-Eyes White Dragon". You can Normal Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in addition to your Normal Summon/Set, and "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" can be Normal Summoned/Set without Tributing.
2: Reveal 1 LIGHT monster from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Cornful Blessings
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Once per Duel if going first, twice
per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 "Cornful Charity" from your Deck or
Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Dark Magic
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Set 1 "Dark Magic Attack" from outside your Deck. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Dark Magician". You can Normal Summon 1 "Dark Magician" in addition to your Normal Summon/Set, and "Dark Magician" can be Normal Summoned/Set without Tributing.
2: Reveal 1 DARK monster from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Divine Healing
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Gain 2000 LP. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Injection Fairy Lily", and you can Normal Summon 1 "Injection Fairy Lily" in addition to your Normal
Summon/Set. "Injection Fairy Lily" can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.
2: Reveal 1 Fairy monster or EARTH monster from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: God's Chosen One
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Before your normal draw, Set 1 "Metal Reflect Slime" from outside of your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.) One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be 1 "Ancient Chant" from your Deck. 
2: Reveal 1 Divine-Beast monster in your hand, then either place that monster on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 card.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Kahyoreigetsu
skills.desc:
This Skill's first effect can be used once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw if your opponent controls a face-up monster with 2500 or more ATK. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be 1 Kahyoreigetsu from your Deck.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Monster Reborn
skills.desc:
Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are at 2500 or below. Your normal draw this turn will be "Monster Reborn," from your Deck. 
If your opponent controls a monster with 3000 ATK or more, you can use this Skill regardless of your Life Points. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Music Princess
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Twice per Duel if going first, thrice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 "Music Princess's Battle Ballet" or "Straight Pierce" from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. (Only one per Duel if "Music Princess's Battle Ballet".) In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Mystical Space Typhoon
skills.desc:
Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are lower than your opponent's. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Mystical Space Typhoon." 
This Skill can be used regardless of your Life Points if there are 3 or more cards in the opponent's Spell/Trap Zone and Field Zone.
This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Pride and Soul
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be activated before your normal draw. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be 1 "Dragon of Pride and Soul" from your Deck. Send all other cards from your hand, Deck, Extra Deck, and field to the Graveyard, and return all of your banished cards to the Graveyard. Then, if you have 25 or more cards in your Graveyard, randomly send 25 cards with the same names as those in your Graveyard from outside of your Deck to your opponent's Graveyard. After using this Skill, you cannot Normal/Special Summon monsters, except "Dragon of Pride and Soul", nor activate card effects for the rest of this Duel.
2: Place 1 "Dragon of Pride and Soul" from your hand on the bottom of your Deck, then draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Primal Illusion
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Once per Duel if going first, twice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 Level 1 Wyrm Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Returning Alive
skills.desc:
[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated before your normal draw from turn 2 onward, if your constructed Deck does not contain more than 1 Warrior Type monster with 2500 DEF. (Once per Duel if going first, twice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 "The Warrior Returning Alive" from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Shape the Future
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Your normal draw this turn will be 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster or 1 "Cynet" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck.
2: Reveal 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster or 1 "Cynet" Card from your hand and either place it at the bottom of your Deck or send it to the GY. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Spirit
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a Spirit monster. This turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except for Spirit monsters, and you can Normal Summon up to 3 times. Also, you can Normal Summon Spirit monsters without Tributing.
2: Reveal 1 Spirit monster or 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: Spirit Barrier
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Your normal draw this turn will be 1 "The Seal of Orichalcos" from your Deck.
2: Reveal 1 Spell/Trap Card in your hand and either place it on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the GY. Then, draw 2 cards.

skills.name: Destiny Draw: The Crimson King
skills.desc:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Play 1 "Number
39: Utopia" from your Extra Deck or GY in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
